Stable Language Guidance for Vision-Language-Action Models

简要说明：该论文提出了一种名为Residual Semantic Steering (RSS) 的框架，通过将物理可供性与语义执行分离，提高视觉-语言-动作模型对语言扰动的鲁棒性，并取得了最先进的结果。

TLDR: The paper introduces Residual Semantic Steering (RSS), a framework to improve the robustness of Vision-Language-Action models against linguistic perturbations by disentangling physical affordance from semantic execution, achieving state-of-the-art results.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated impressive capabilities in generalized robotic control; however, they remain notoriously brittle to linguistic perturbations. We identify a critical ``modality collapse'' phenomenon where strong visual priors overwhelm sparse linguistic signals, causing agents to overfit to specific instruction phrasings while ignoring the underlying semantic intent. To address this, we propose \textbf{Residual Semantic Steering (RSS)}, a probabilistic framework that disentangles physical affordance from semantic execution. RSS introduces two theoretical innovations: (1) \textbf{Monte Carlo Syntactic Integration}, which approximates the true semantic posterior via dense, LLM-driven distributional expansion, and (2) \textbf{Residual Affordance Steering}, a dual-stream decoding mechanism that explicitly isolates the causal influence of language by subtracting the visual affordance prior. Theoretical analysis suggests that RSS effectively maximizes the mutual information between action and intent while suppressing visual distractors. Empirical results across diverse manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that RSS achieves state-of-the-art robustness, maintaining performance even under adversarial linguistic perturbations.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型已经在通用机器人控制中展现出令人印象深刻的能力；然而，它们对语言扰动的鲁棒性仍然非常差。我们发现了一种关键的“模态坍塌”现象，其中强视觉先验压倒了稀疏的语言信号，导致智能体过度拟合特定的指令措辞，而忽略了潜在的语义意图。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了\textbf{残差语义引导(RSS)}，一个解耦物理可供性和语义执行的概率框架。RSS引入了两项理论创新：(1)\textbf{蒙特卡洛句法积分}，它通过密集、由LLM驱动的分布扩展来近似真实的语义后验；(2)\textbf{残差可供性引导}，一种双流解码机制，通过减去视觉可供性先验来显式隔离语言的因果影响。理论分析表明，RSS有效地最大化了动作和意图之间的互信息，同时抑制了视觉干扰。在各种操作基准上的经验结果表明，RSS实现了最先进的鲁棒性，即使在对抗性语言扰动下也能保持性能。

Authors: Zhihao Zhan, Yuhao Chen, Jiaying Zhou, Qinhan Lv, Hao Liu, Keze Wang, Liang Lin, Guangrun Wang

PointWorld: Scaling 3D World Models for In-The-Wild Robotic Manipulation

简要说明：PointWorld 提出了一个大型预训练的 3D 世界模型，通过 RGB-D 图像和机器人动作预测 3D 点流，从而无需任何训练即可在现实环境中实现多功能的机器人操作。

TLDR: PointWorld introduces a large pre-trained 3D world model that predicts 3D point flows from RGB-D images and robot actions, enabling versatile robotic manipulation in real-world environments with zero-shot transfer.

Abstract: Humans anticipate, from a glance and a contemplated action of their bodies, how the 3D world will respond, a capability that is equally vital for robotic manipulation. We introduce PointWorld, a large pre-trained 3D world model that unifies state and action in a shared 3D space as 3D point flows: given one or few RGB-D images and a sequence of low-level robot action commands, PointWorld forecasts per-pixel displacements in 3D that respond to the given actions. By representing actions as 3D point flows instead of embodiment-specific action spaces (e.g., joint positions), this formulation directly conditions on physical geometries of robots while seamlessly integrating learning across embodiments. To train our 3D world model, we curate a large-scale dataset spanning real and simulated robotic manipulation in open-world environments, enabled by recent advances in 3D vision and simulated environments, totaling about 2M trajectories and 500 hours across a single-arm Franka and a bimanual humanoid. Through rigorous, large-scale empirical studies of backbones, action representations, learning objectives, partial observability, data mixtures, domain transfers, and scaling, we distill design principles for large-scale 3D world modeling. With a real-time (0.1s) inference speed, PointWorld can be efficiently integrated in the model-predictive control (MPC) framework for manipulation. We demonstrate that a single pre-trained checkpoint enables a real-world Franka robot to perform rigid-body pushing, deformable and articulated object manipulation, and tool use, without requiring any demonstrations or post-training and all from a single image captured in-the-wild. Project website at https://point-world.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：人类能够通过一瞥和对身体动作的思考来预测3D世界将如何响应，这种能力对于机器人操作同样至关重要。我们引入PointWorld，一个大型预训练的3D世界模型，它将状态和动作统一在一个共享的3D空间中，表示为3D点流：给定一个或几个RGB-D图像以及一系列低级机器人动作指令，PointWorld预测3D空间中每个像素的位移，这些位移响应于给定的动作。通过将动作表示为3D点流，而不是特定于具体机器人的动作空间（例如，关节位置），这种表示方法直接基于机器人的物理几何信息，同时无缝集成跨不同机器人的学习。为了训练我们的3D世界模型，我们策划了一个大规模数据集，涵盖了真实和模拟环境中的机器人操作，得益于3D视觉和模拟环境的最新进展，总共包含大约200万条轨迹和500小时的数据，涉及单臂Franka机器人和双臂人形机器人。通过对骨干网络、动作表示、学习目标、部分可观测性、数据混合、领域迁移和缩放进行严格的大规模实证研究，我们提炼出用于大规模3D世界模型设计的原则。凭借实时（0.1秒）的推理速度，PointWorld可以有效地集成到用于操作的模型预测控制（MPC）框架中。我们证明，单个预训练的检查点使得真实世界的Franka机器人能够执行刚体推移、可变形和铰接物体操作以及工具使用，而无需任何演示或后训练，并且全部来自在野外捕获的单个图像。项目网站位于https://point-world.github.io/。

Authors: Wenlong Huang, Yu-Wei Chao, Arsalan Mousavian, Ming-Yu Liu, Dieter Fox, Kaichun Mo, Li Fei-Fei

Wow, wo, val! A Comprehensive Embodied World Model Evaluation Turing Test

简要说明：该论文介绍了 WoW-World-Eval，一个用于评估视频基础模型在具身人工智能中作为世界模型的基准，揭示了模型在时空一致性、物理推理和现实世界执行方面的局限性。

TLDR: This paper introduces WoW-World-Eval, a benchmark for evaluating video foundation models as world models in embodied AI, revealing limitations in spatiotemporal consistency, physical reasoning, and real-world execution.

Abstract: As world models gain momentum in Embodied AI, an increasing number of works explore using video foundation models as predictive world models for downstream embodied tasks like 3D prediction or interactive generation. However, before exploring these downstream tasks, video foundation models still have two critical questions unanswered: (1) whether their generative generalization is sufficient to maintain perceptual fidelity in the eyes of human observers, and (2) whether they are robust enough to serve as a universal prior for real-world embodied agents. To provide a standardized framework for answering these questions, we introduce the Embodied Turing Test benchmark: WoW-World-Eval (Wow,wo,val). Building upon 609 robot manipulation data, Wow-wo-val examines five core abilities, including perception, planning, prediction, generalization, and execution. We propose a comprehensive evaluation protocol with 22 metrics to assess the models' generation ability, which achieves a high Pearson Correlation between the overall score and human preference (>0.93) and establishes a reliable foundation for the Human Turing Test. On Wow-wo-val, models achieve only 17.27 on long-horizon planning and at best 68.02 on physical consistency, indicating limited spatiotemporal consistency and physical reasoning. For the Inverse Dynamic Model Turing Test, we first use an IDM to evaluate the video foundation models' execution accuracy in the real world. However, most models collapse to $\approx$ 0% success, while WoW maintains a 40.74% success rate. These findings point to a noticeable gap between the generated videos and the real world, highlighting the urgency and necessity of benchmarking World Model in Embodied AI.

摘要（中文）：随着世界模型在具身智能领域日益受到重视，越来越多的研究探索使用视频基础模型作为预测世界模型，用于三维预测或交互式生成等下游具身任务。然而，在探索这些下游任务之前，视频基础模型仍有两个关键问题尚未解答：（1）它们的生成泛化能力是否足以在人类观察者眼中保持感知保真度，以及（2）它们是否足够稳健，能够作为真实世界具身智能体的通用先验。为了提供一个标准化的框架来回答这些问题，我们引入了具身图灵测试基准：WoW-World-Eval (Wow,wo,val)。基于609个机器人操作数据，Wow-wo-val 考察了五个核心能力，包括感知、规划、预测、泛化和执行。我们提出了一套包含22个指标的综合评估协议，用于评估模型的生成能力，该协议在总体得分和人类偏好之间实现了较高的皮尔逊相关性（>0.93），并为人类图灵测试奠定了可靠的基础。在Wow-wo-val上，模型在长时程规划中仅达到 17.27，在物理一致性方面最佳达到 68.02，表明其时空一致性和物理推理能力有限。对于逆动力学模型图灵测试，我们首先使用IDM来评估视频基础模型在真实世界中的执行精度。然而，大多数模型的成功率降至约为 0%，而 WoW 保持了 40.74% 的成功率。这些发现表明生成的视频与真实世界之间存在显著差距，突出了在具身智能领域对世界模型进行基准测试的紧迫性和必要性。

Authors: Chun-Kai Fan, Xiaowei Chi, Xiaozhu Ju, Hao Li, Yong Bao, Yu-Kai Wang, Lizhang Chen, Zhiyuan Jiang, Kuangzhi Ge, Ying Li, Weishi Mi, Qingpo Wuwu, Peidong Jia, Yulin Luo, Kevin Zhang, Zhiyuan Qin, Yong Dai, Sirui Han, Yike Guo, Shanghang Zhang, Jian Tang

CLAP: Contrastive Latent Action Pretraining for Learning Vision-Language-Action Models from Human Videos

简要说明：该论文介绍了CLAP，一个对比学习框架，它将人类视频的视觉潜在空间与机器人的本体感受空间对齐，从而能够有效地将技能转移到机器人执行。他们基于此框架提出了CLAP-NTP和CLAP-RF，并使用知识匹配来减轻微调过程中的灾难性遗忘。

TLDR: The paper introduces CLAP, a contrastive learning framework that aligns visual latent spaces from human videos with robot proprioceptive spaces, enabling effective transfer of skills to robotic execution. They propose CLAP-NTP and CLAP-RF based on this framework and mitigate catastrophic forgetting during fine-tuning using Knowledge Matching.

Abstract: Generalist Vision-Language-Action models are currently hindered by the scarcity of robotic data compared to the abundance of human video demonstrations. Existing Latent Action Models attempt to leverage video data but often suffer from visual entanglement, capturing noise rather than manipulation skills. To address this, we propose Contrastive Latent Action Pretraining (CLAP), a framework that aligns the visual latent space from videos with a proprioceptive latent space from robot trajectories. By employing contrastive learning, CLAP maps video transitions onto a quantized, physically executable codebook. Building on this representation, we introduce a dual-formulation VLA framework offering both CLAP-NTP, an autoregressive model excelling at instruction following and object generalization, and CLAP-RF, a Rectified Flow-based policy designed for high-frequency, precise manipulation. Furthermore, we propose a Knowledge Matching (KM) regularization strategy to mitigate catastrophic forgetting during fine-tuning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CLAP significantly outperforms strong baselines, enabling the effective transfer of skills from human videos to robotic execution. Project page: https://lin-shan.com/CLAP/.

摘要（中文）：通用视觉-语言-动作模型目前受到机器人数据稀缺的限制，相比之下，人类视频演示则非常丰富。现有的潜在动作模型试图利用视频数据，但常常遭受视觉纠缠的影响，捕获的是噪声而非操作技能。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了对比潜在动作预训练（CLAP），一个将视频中的视觉潜在空间与机器人轨迹中的本体感受潜在空间对齐的框架。通过采用对比学习，CLAP将视频转换映射到一个量化的、物理上可执行的代码本。基于这种表示，我们引入了一个双重公式的VLA框架，提供CLAP-NTP（一个擅长指令跟随和对象泛化的自回归模型）和CLAP-RF（一个为高频、精确操作设计的基于修正流的策略）。此外，我们提出了一种知识匹配（KM）正则化策略，以减轻微调过程中的灾难性遗忘。大量实验表明，CLAP显著优于强大的基线模型，从而能够有效地将技能从人类视频转移到机器人执行。项目主页：https://lin-shan.com/CLAP/.

Authors: Chubin Zhang, Jianan Wang, Zifeng Gao, Yue Su, Tianru Dai, Cai Zhou, Jiwen Lu, Yansong Tang

CoINS: Counterfactual Interactive Navigation via Skill-Aware VLM

简要说明：该论文介绍了CoINS，一个层级框架，它使用具有技能意识的VLM使机器人能够与物体交互以在杂乱的环境中导航，在模拟和真实世界的环境中都比基线方法取得了显著的改进。

TLDR: The paper introduces CoINS, a hierarchical framework that uses a skill-aware VLM to enable robots to interact with objects to navigate cluttered environments, achieving significant improvements over baselines in simulated and real-world settings.

Abstract: Recent Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated significant potential in robotic planning. However, they typically function as semantic reasoners, lacking an intrinsic understanding of the specific robot's physical capabilities. This limitation is particularly critical in interactive navigation, where robots must actively modify cluttered environments to create traversable paths. Existing VLM-based navigators are predominantly confined to passive obstacle avoidance, failing to reason about when and how to interact with objects to clear blocked paths. To bridge this gap, we propose Counterfactual Interactive Navigation via Skill-aware VLM (CoINS), a hierarchical framework that integrates skill-aware reasoning and robust low-level execution. Specifically, we fine-tune a VLM, named InterNav-VLM, which incorporates skill affordance and concrete constraint parameters into the input context and grounds them into a metric-scale environmental representation. By internalizing the logic of counterfactual reasoning through fine-tuning on the proposed InterNav dataset, the model learns to implicitly evaluate the causal effects of object removal on navigation connectivity, thereby determining interaction necessity and target selection. To execute the generated high-level plans, we develop a comprehensive skill library through reinforcement learning, specifically introducing traversability-oriented strategies to manipulate diverse objects for path clearance. A systematic benchmark in Isaac Sim is proposed to evaluate both the reasoning and execution aspects of interactive navigation. Extensive simulations and real-world experiments demonstrate that CoINS significantly outperforms representative baselines, achieving a 17\% higher overall success rate and over 80\% improvement in complex long-horizon scenarios compared to the best-performing baseline

摘要（中文）：近期视觉-语言模型(VLMs)已在机器人规划中展现出巨大的潜力。然而，它们通常作为语义推理器发挥作用，缺乏对特定机器人物理能力的内在理解。这种局限性在交互式导航中尤为关键，因为机器人必须主动修改杂乱的环境以创建可通行路径。现有的基于VLM的导航器主要局限于被动避障，无法推理何时以及如何与物体交互来清理受阻路径。为了弥合这一差距，我们提出了一种通过技能感知VLM进行反事实交互式导航(CoINS)的分层框架，该框架集成了技能感知推理和鲁棒的底层执行。具体而言，我们微调了一个名为InterNav-VLM 的VLM，它将技能可供性和具体的约束参数纳入输入上下文，并将它们与度量尺度的环境表示对齐。通过在提出的InterNav 数据集上微调，内化反事实推理的逻辑，该模型学习隐式地评估移除物体对导航连通性的因果效应，从而确定交互的必要性和目标选择。为了执行生成的高级规划，我们通过强化学习开发了一个全面的技能库，特别引入了面向可通行性的策略，以操纵不同的物体来清理路径。我们提出了一个在Isaac Sim中的系统性基准测试，以评估交互式导航的推理和执行方面。大量的仿真和真实世界实验表明，CoINS显著优于具有代表性的基线方法，与性能最佳的基线方法相比，总体成功率提高了17%，并在复杂的长时程场景中改进超过80%。

Authors: Kangjie Zhou, Zhejia Wen, Zhiyong Zhuo, Zike Yan, Pengying Wu, Ieng Hou U, Shuaiyang Li, Han Gao, Kang Ding, Wenhan Cao, Wei Pan, Chang Liu

Locomotion Beyond Feet

简要说明：本文介绍了一种名为“超越足部的运动”的系统，用于在复杂地形上进行全身人形机器人运动，该系统结合了基于物理的关键帧动画和强化学习以及基于视觉的技能规划，并通过真实世界的实验进行了演示。

TLDR: This paper presents a system called "Locomotion Beyond Feet" for whole-body humanoid locomotion on challenging terrains, combining physics-grounded keyframe animation with reinforcement learning and vision-based skill planning, demonstrated through real-world experiments.

Abstract: Most locomotion methods for humanoid robots focus on leg-based gaits, yet natural bipeds frequently rely on hands, knees, and elbows to establish additional contacts for stability and support in complex environments. This paper introduces Locomotion Beyond Feet, a comprehensive system for whole-body humanoid locomotion across extremely challenging terrains, including low-clearance spaces under chairs, knee-high walls, knee-high platforms, and steep ascending and descending stairs. Our approach addresses two key challenges: contact-rich motion planning and generalization across diverse terrains. To this end, we combine physics-grounded keyframe animation with reinforcement learning. Keyframes encode human knowledge of motor skills, are embodiment-specific, and can be readily validated in simulation or on hardware, while reinforcement learning transforms these references into robust, physically accurate motions. We further employ a hierarchical framework consisting of terrain-specific motion-tracking policies, failure recovery mechanisms, and a vision-based skill planner. Real-world experiments demonstrate that Locomotion Beyond Feet achieves robust whole-body locomotion and generalizes across obstacle sizes, obstacle instances, and terrain sequences.

摘要（中文）：针对人形机器人的大多数移动方法侧重于基于腿的步态，然而，自然的双足动物经常依赖手、膝盖和肘部建立额外的接触点，从而在复杂的环境中获得稳定性和支撑。本文介绍“超越双足的移动”，一个全面的全身人形机器人移动系统，适用于极具挑战性的地形，包括椅子下的低矮空间、齐膝高的墙壁、齐膝高的平台以及陡峭的上下楼梯。 我们的方法解决了两个关键挑战：富接触的运动规划和跨多样化地形的泛化。 为此，我们将基于物理的关键帧动画与强化学习相结合。 关键帧编码了人类的运动技能知识，是特定于载体的，并且可以在模拟或硬件中轻松验证，而强化学习将这些参考转化为鲁棒的、物理精确的运动。 我们进一步采用了一个分层框架，该框架由特定于地形的运动跟踪策略、故障恢复机制和基于视觉的技能规划器组成。 真实世界的实验表明，“超越双足的移动”实现了鲁棒的全身移动，并可以在障碍物尺寸、障碍物实例和地形序列之间进行泛化。

Authors: Tae Hoon Yang, Haochen Shi, Jiacheng Hu, Zhicong Zhang, Daniel Jiang, Weizhuo Wang, Yao He, Zhen Wu, Yuming Chen, Yifan Hou, Monroe Kennedy, Shuran Song, C. Karen Liu

A Vision-Language-Action Model with Visual Prompt for OFF-Road Autonomous Driving

简要说明：该论文介绍了一种名为 OFF-EMMA 的新型视觉-语言-动作框架，用于越野自动驾驶。该框架利用视觉提示和链式思考推理策略，提高了轨迹规划的准确性和鲁棒性，并在 RELLIS-3D 数据集上取得了显著的性能提升。

TLDR: The paper introduces OFF-EMMA, a novel vision-language-action framework for off-road autonomous driving that uses visual prompts and a chain-of-thought reasoning strategy to improve trajectory planning accuracy and robustness, achieving significant performance improvements over existing methods on the RELLIS-3D dataset.

Abstract: Efficient trajectory planning in off-road terrains presents a formidable challenge for autonomous vehicles, often necessitating complex multi-step pipelines. However, traditional approaches exhibit limited adaptability in dynamic environments. To address these limitations, this paper proposes OFF-EMMA, a novel end-to-end multimodal framework designed to overcome the deficiencies of insufficient spatial perception and unstable reasoning in visual-language-action (VLA) models for off-road autonomous driving scenarios. The framework explicitly annotates input images through the design of a visual prompt block and introduces a chain-of-thought with self-consistency (COT-SC) reasoning strategy to enhance the accuracy and robustness of trajectory planning. The visual prompt block utilizes semantic segmentation masks as visual prompts, enhancing the spatial understanding ability of pre-trained visual-language models for complex terrains. The COT- SC strategy effectively mitigates the error impact of outliers on planning performance through a multi-path reasoning mechanism. Experimental results on the RELLIS-3D off-road dataset demonstrate that OFF-EMMA significantly outperforms existing methods, reducing the average L2 error of the Qwen backbone model by 13.3% and decreasing the failure rate from 16.52% to 6.56%.

摘要（中文）：在非道路地形中进行高效的轨迹规划对于自动驾驶车辆来说是一个艰巨的挑战，通常需要复杂的多步骤流程。然而，传统方法在动态环境中的适应性有限。为了解决这些局限性，本文提出了一种新的端到端多模态框架OFF-EMMA，旨在克服视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在非道路自动驾驶场景中存在的空间感知不足和推理不稳定的缺陷。该框架通过设计视觉提示块来显式地标注输入图像，并引入具有自我一致性的链式思考（COT-SC）推理策略，以提高轨迹规划的准确性和鲁棒性。视觉提示块利用语义分割掩码作为视觉提示，增强预训练的视觉-语言模型对复杂地形的空间理解能力。COT-SC策略通过多路径推理机制有效地减轻了离群值对规划性能的误差影响。在RELLIS-3D非道路数据集上的实验结果表明，OFF-EMMA显著优于现有方法，将Qwen骨干模型的平均L2误差降低了13.3%，并将失败率从16.52%降至6.56%。

Authors: Liangdong Zhang, Yiming Nie, Haoyang Li, Fanjie Kong, Baobao Zhang, Shunxin Huang, Kai Fu, Chen Min, Liang Xiao

FIRE-VLM: A Vision-Language-Driven Reinforcement Learning Framework for UAV Wildfire Tracking in a Physics-Grounded Fire Digital Twin

简要说明：本文介绍了FIRE-VLM，一个由视觉-语言模型引导的强化学习框架，它在高保真野火数字孪生中训练，用于自主无人机野火跟踪。结果显示，该框架在检测时间和视野内时间方面有显著提升。

TLDR: This paper introduces FIRE-VLM, a reinforcement learning framework guided by vision-language models and trained in a high-fidelity wildfire digital twin for autonomous UAV wildfire tracking, showing significant improvements in detection time and field-of-view time.

Abstract: Wildfire monitoring demands autonomous systems capable of reasoning under extreme visual degradation, rapidly evolving physical dynamics, and scarce real-world training data. Existing UAV navigation approaches rely on simplified simulators and supervised perception pipelines, and lack embodied agents interacting with physically realistic fire environments. We introduce FIRE-VLM, the first end-to-end vision-language model (VLM) guided reinforcement learning (RL) framework trained entirely within a high-fidelity, physics-grounded wildfire digital twin. Built from USGS Digital Elevation Model (DEM) terrain, LANDFIRE fuel inventories, and semi-physical fire-spread solvers, this twin captures terrain-induced runs, wind-driven acceleration, smoke plume occlusion, and dynamic fuel consumption. Within this environment, a PPO agent with dual-view UAV sensing is guided by a CLIP-style VLM. Wildfire-specific semantic alignment scores, derived from a single prompt describing active fire and smoke plumes, are integrated as potential-based reward shaping signals. Our contributions are: (1) a GIS-to-simulation pipeline for constructing wildfire digital twins; (2) a VLM-guided RL agent for UAV firefront tracking; and (3) a wildfire-aware reward design that combines physical terms with VLM semantics. Across five digital-twin evaluation tasks, our VLM-guided policy reduces time-to-detection by up to 6 times, increases time-in-FOV, and is, to our knowledge, the first RL-based UAV wildfire monitoring system demonstrated in kilometer-scale, physics-grounded digital-twin fires.

摘要（中文）：野火监测需要能够在极端视觉退化、快速演化的物理动态和稀缺的真实世界训练数据下进行推理的自主系统。现有的无人机导航方法依赖于简化的模拟器和监督感知流程，并且缺乏与物理真实野火环境交互的具身智能体。我们引入FIRE-VLM，这是第一个端到端视觉-语言模型（VLM）引导的强化学习（RL）框架，完全在高保真、物理基础的野火数字孪生中训练。该孪生体基于美国地质调查局（USGS）的数字高程模型（DEM）地形、LANDFIRE燃料清单和半物理火蔓延求解器构建，捕捉了地形诱导的蔓延、风力驱动的加速、烟羽遮挡和动态燃料消耗。在该环境中，具有双视角无人机感知的PPO智能体由CLIP风格的VLM引导。从描述活跃火灾和烟羽的单个提示中获得的野火特定语义对齐分数被整合为基于势的奖励塑造信号。我们的贡献包括：（1）构建野火数字孪生的GIS到仿真的流水线；（2）用于无人机火线跟踪的VLM引导的RL智能体；以及（3）结合物理项与VLM语义的野火感知奖励设计。在五个数字孪生评估任务中，我们的VLM引导策略将检测时间缩短高达6倍，增加了视场停留时间，并且据我们所知，是第一个在公里级、物理基础的数字孪生火灾中演示的基于RL的无人机野火监测系统。

Authors: Chris Webb, Mobin Habibpour, Mayamin Hamid Raha, Ali Reza Tavakkoli, Janice Coen, Fatemeh Afghah

Towards Zero-Knowledge Task Planning via a Language-based Approach

简要说明：本文介绍了零知识任务规划 (ZKTP)，利用大型语言模型将指令分解为子任务，生成行为树，并在 AI2-THOR 模拟器中动态调整它们，优于特定于任务的方法。

TLDR: This paper introduces Zero-Knowledge Task Planning (ZKTP), using LLMs to decompose instructions, generate behavior trees, and adapt them dynamically in the AI2-THOR simulator, outperforming task-specific approaches.

Abstract: In this work, we introduce and formalize the Zero-Knowledge Task Planning (ZKTP) problem, i.e., formulating a sequence of actions to achieve some goal without task-specific knowledge. Additionally, we present a first investigation and approach for ZKTP that leverages a large language model (LLM) to decompose natural language instructions into subtasks and generate behavior trees (BTs) for execution. If errors arise during task execution, the approach also uses an LLM to adjust the BTs on-the-fly in a refinement loop. Experimental validation in the AI2-THOR simulator demonstrate our approach's effectiveness in improving overall task performance compared to alternative approaches that leverage task-specific knowledge. Our work demonstrates the potential of LLMs to effectively address several aspects of the ZKTP problem, providing a robust framework for automated behavior generation with no task-specific setup.

摘要（中文）：本文提出并形式化了零知识任务规划（ZKTP）问题，即在不具备任务特定知识的情况下，构建一系列动作以达成某个目标。此外，我们提出了一种针对ZKTP的首个研究与方法，该方法利用大型语言模型（LLM）将自然语言指令分解为子任务，并生成行为树（BT）用于执行。在任务执行过程中，如果出现错误，该方法还会使用LLM以在线调整的方式在精炼循环中调整BT。在AI2-THOR模拟器中的实验验证表明，与利用任务特定知识的替代方法相比，我们的方法在提高整体任务性能方面是有效的。我们的工作展示了LLM在有效解决ZKTP问题的多个方面的潜力，为在无需任务特定设置的情况下实现自动化行为生成提供了一个稳健的框架。

Authors: Liam Merz Hoffmeister, Brian Scassellati, Daniel Rakita

InfiniteWeb: Scalable Web Environment Synthesis for GUI Agent Training

简要说明：InfiniteWeb通过自动生成大规模功能性网页环境来解决GUI代理训练环境匮乏的问题，从而提升了代理在基准测试任务上的训练和表现。

TLDR: InfiniteWeb addresses the scarcity of training environments for GUI agents by automatically generating functional web environments at scale, enabling better agent training and performance on benchmark tasks.

Abstract: GUI agents that interact with graphical interfaces on behalf of users represent a promising direction for practical AI assistants. However, training such agents is hindered by the scarcity of suitable environments. We present InfiniteWeb, a system that automatically generates functional web environments at scale for GUI agent training. While LLMs perform well on generating a single webpage, building a realistic and functional website with many interconnected pages faces challenges. We address these challenges through unified specification, task-centric test-driven development, and a combination of website seed with reference design image to ensure diversity. Our system also generates verifiable task evaluators enabling dense reward signals for reinforcement learning. Experiments show that InfiniteWeb surpasses commercial coding agents at realistic website construction, and GUI agents trained on our generated environments achieve significant performance improvements on OSWorld and Online-Mind2Web, demonstrating the effectiveness of proposed system.

摘要（中文）：能够代表用户与图形界面交互的GUI智能体是实用AI助手的一个有前景的方向。然而，训练此类智能体受到适合环境稀缺的阻碍。我们提出了InfiniteWeb，一个能够大规模自动生成功能性web环境，用于GUI智能体训练的系统。虽然LLM在生成单个网页方面表现良好，但构建一个包含许多互连页面的逼真且功能齐全的网站面临挑战。我们通过统一规范、以任务为中心的测试驱动开发以及网站种子与参考设计图像的结合来确保多样性，从而解决这些挑战。我们的系统还生成可验证的任务评估器，从而为强化学习提供密集的奖励信号。实验表明，InfiniteWeb在构建逼真网站方面超越了商业编码智能体，并且在我们生成的环境上训练的GUI智能体在OSWorld和Online-Mind2Web上取得了显著的性能提升，证明了所提出系统的有效性。

Authors: Ziyun Zhang, Zezhou Wang, Xiaoyi Zhang, Zongyu Guo, Jiahao Li, Bin Li, Yan Lu

Analyzing Reasoning Consistency in Large Multimodal Models under Cross-Modal Conflicts

简要说明：该论文指出大型多模态模型(LMMs)在视频推理中存在“文本惯性”问题，即文本幻觉会导致错误在推理过程中传播，并提出了一种免训练的推理范式来缓解这个问题。

TLDR: The paper identifies and addresses a 'textual inertia' problem in Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) where textual hallucinations propagate errors in video reasoning, and proposes a training-free inference paradigm to mitigate this issue.

Abstract: Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in video reasoning via Chain-of-Thought (CoT). However, the robustness of their reasoning chains remains questionable. In this paper, we identify a critical failure mode termed textual inertia, where once a textual hallucination occurs in the thinking process, models tend to blindly adhere to the erroneous text while neglecting conflicting visual evidence. To systematically investigate this, we propose the LogicGraph Perturbation Protocol that structurally injects perturbations into the reasoning chains of diverse LMMs spanning both native reasoning architectures and prompt-driven paradigms to evaluate their self-reflection capabilities. The results reveal that models successfully self-correct in less than 10% of cases and predominantly succumb to blind textual error propagation. To mitigate this, we introduce Active Visual-Context Refinement, a training-free inference paradigm which orchestrates an active visual re-grounding mechanism to enforce fine-grained verification coupled with an adaptive context refinement strategy to summarize and denoise the reasoning history. Experiments demonstrate that our approach significantly stifles hallucination propagation and enhances reasoning robustness.

摘要（中文）：大型多模态模型（LMM）已经通过思维链（CoT）展示了令人印象深刻的视频推理能力。然而，它们推理链的鲁棒性仍然值得怀疑。在本文中，我们发现了一种关键的失效模式，称为文本惯性，即一旦在思考过程中出现文本幻觉，模型往往会盲目地遵循错误的文本，而忽略冲突的视觉证据。为了系统地研究这个问题，我们提出了逻辑图扰动协议，该协议将结构性的扰动注入到各种LMM的推理链中，涵盖了原生推理架构和提示驱动范例，以评估它们的自我反思能力。结果表明，模型在不到10%的情况下成功地进行了自我纠正，并且主要屈服于盲目的文本错误传播。为了缓解这个问题，我们引入了主动视觉上下文精炼，这是一种无需训练的推理范例，它协调主动视觉重置机制以强制执行细粒度的验证，并结合自适应上下文精炼策略来总结和降噪推理历史。实验表明，我们的方法显著抑制了幻觉传播并增强了推理的鲁棒性。

Authors: Zhihao Zhu, Jiafeng Liang, Shixin Jiang, Jinlan Fu, Ming Liu, Guanglu Sun, See-Kiong Ng, Bing Qin

MobileDreamer: Generative Sketch World Model for GUI Agent

简要说明：该论文介绍了MobileDreamer，一个基于世界模型的移动GUI代理框架，它使用文本草图世界模型来有效地预测动作后的状态，从而提高长时程任务的性能。

TLDR: The paper introduces MobileDreamer, a world-model-based framework for mobile GUI agents that uses a textual sketch world model for efficient prediction of post-action states, improving long-horizon task performance.

Abstract: Mobile GUI agents have shown strong potential in real-world automation and practical applications. However, most existing agents remain reactive, making decisions mainly from current screen, which limits their performance on long-horizon tasks. Building a world model from repeated interactions enables forecasting action outcomes and supports better decision making for mobile GUI agents. This is challenging because the model must predict post-action states with spatial awareness while remaining efficient enough for practical deployment. In this paper, we propose MobileDreamer, an efficient world-model-based lookahead framework to equip the GUI agents based on the future imagination provided by the world model. It consists of textual sketch world model and rollout imagination for GUI agent. Textual sketch world model forecasts post-action states through a learning process to transform digital images into key task-related sketches, and designs a novel order-invariant learning strategy to preserve the spatial information of GUI elements. The rollout imagination strategy for GUI agent optimizes the action-selection process by leveraging the prediction capability of world model. Experiments on Android World show that MobileDreamer achieves state-of-the-art performance and improves task success by 5.25%. World model evaluations further verify that our textual sketch modeling accurately forecasts key GUI elements.

摘要（中文）：移动GUI代理已在实际自动化和实际应用中展现出强大的潜力。然而，现有的大多数代理仍然是反应式的，主要根据当前屏幕做出决策，这限制了它们在长周期任务中的表现。从重复交互中构建世界模型能够预测行动结果，并为移动GUI代理提供更好的决策支持。这具有挑战性，因为该模型必须具备空间感知能力地预测行动后的状态，同时保持足够的效率以供实际部署。在本文中，我们提出了MobileDreamer，一个高效的、基于世界模型的、前瞻框架，旨在通过世界模型提供的未来想象来增强GUI代理的能力。它由文本草图世界模型和GUI代理的展开想象组成。文本草图世界模型通过一个学习过程来预测行动后的状态，该过程将数字图像转换为与任务相关的关键草图，并设计了一种新颖的顺序不变的学习策略来保存GUI元素的空间信息。GUI代理的展开想象策略利用世界模型的预测能力来优化行动选择过程。在Android World上的实验表明，MobileDreamer取得了最先进的性能，并将任务成功率提高了5.25%。世界模型评估进一步验证了我们的文本草图建模能够准确预测关键的GUI元素。

Authors: Yilin Cao, Yufeng Zhong, Zhixiong Zeng, Liming Zheng, Jing Huang, Haibo Qiu, Peng Shi, Wenji Mao, Wan Guanglu

Anti-Length Shift: Dynamic Outlier Truncation for Training Efficient Reasoning Models

简要说明：该论文介绍了一种名为动态离群点截断（DOT）的方法，通过在训练过程中选择性地抑制冗余token，来减少推理模型中的token使用量，从而在不影响准确性的前提下显著提高效率。

TLDR: This paper introduces Dynamic Outlier Truncation (DOT), a method that reduces inference token usage in reasoning models by selectively suppressing redundant tokens during training, leading to significant efficiency gains without compromising accuracy.

Abstract: Large reasoning models enhanced by reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards have achieved significant performance gains by extending their chain-of-thought. However, this paradigm incurs substantial deployment costs as models often exhibit excessive verbosity on simple queries. Existing efficient reasoning methods relying on explicit length penalties often introduce optimization conflicts and leave the generative mechanisms driving overthinking largely unexamined. In this paper, we identify a phenomenon termed length shift where models increasingly generate unnecessary reasoning on trivial inputs during training. To address this, we introduce Dynamic Outlier Truncation (DOT), a training-time intervention that selectively suppresses redundant tokens. This method targets only the extreme tail of response lengths within fully correct rollout groups while preserving long-horizon reasoning capabilities for complex problems. To complement this intervention and ensure stable convergence, we further incorporate auxiliary KL regularization and predictive dynamic sampling. Experimental results across multiple model scales demonstrate that our approach significantly pushes the efficiency-performance Pareto frontier outward. Notably, on the AIME-24, our method reduces inference token usage by 78% while simultaneously increasing accuracy compared to the initial policy and surpassing state-of-the-art efficient reasoning methods.

摘要（中文）：通过可验证奖励的强化学习增强的大型推理模型，通过扩展其思维链取得了显著的性能提升。然而，这种范式带来了巨大的部署成本，因为模型在简单查询上通常表现出过度的冗长性。现有的依赖于显式长度惩罚的高效推理方法通常会引入优化冲突，并且基本没有检验驱动过度思考的生成机制。在本文中，我们发现了一种称为长度偏移的现象，即模型在训练过程中越来越多地对简单输入产生不必要的推理。为了解决这个问题，我们引入了动态离群值截断（DOT），这是一种训练时干预措施，选择性地抑制冗余token。该方法仅针对完全正确的rollout组中响应长度的极端尾部，同时保留了复杂问题的长程推理能力。为了补充这种干预并确保稳定的收敛，我们进一步结合了辅助KL正则化和预测动态采样。跨多种模型规模的实验结果表明，我们的方法显著地将效率-性能帕累托前沿推向外侧。值得注意的是，在AIME-24上，与初始策略相比，我们的方法将推理token的使用量减少了78%，同时提高了准确率，并超过了最先进的高效推理方法。

Authors: Wei Wu, Liyi Chen, Congxi Xiao, Tianfu Wang, Qimeng Wang, Chengqiang Lu, Yan Gao, Yi Wu, Yao Hu, Hui Xiong

FocusUI: Efficient UI Grounding via Position-Preserving Visual Token Selection

简要说明：该论文介绍了FocusUI，一个高效的UI元素定位框架，通过智能选择相关的视觉tokens并保持位置连续性，从而在保持准确性的同时，实现更快的推理速度和更低的内存使用。

TLDR: The paper introduces FocusUI, a framework that efficiently grounds UI elements by intelligently selecting relevant visual tokens and preserving positional continuity, leading to faster inference and lower memory usage while maintaining accuracy.

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have shown remarkable performance in User Interface (UI) grounding tasks, driven by their ability to process increasingly high-resolution screenshots. However, screenshots are tokenized into thousands of visual tokens (e.g., about 4700 for 2K resolution), incurring significant computational overhead and diluting attention. In contrast, humans typically focus on regions of interest when interacting with UI. In this work, we pioneer the task of efficient UI grounding. Guided by practical analysis of the task's characteristics and challenges, we propose FocusUI, an efficient UI grounding framework that selects patches most relevant to the instruction while preserving positional continuity for precise grounding. FocusUI addresses two key challenges: (1) Eliminating redundant tokens in visual encoding. We construct patch-level supervision by fusing an instruction-conditioned score with a rule-based UI-graph score that down-weights large homogeneous regions to select distinct and instruction-relevant visual tokens. (2) Preserving positional continuity during visual token selection. We find that general visual token pruning methods suffer from severe accuracy degradation on UI grounding tasks due to broken positional information. We introduce a novel PosPad strategy, which compresses each contiguous sequence of dropped visual tokens into a single special marker placed at the sequence's last index to preserve positional continuity. Comprehensive experiments on four grounding benchmarks demonstrate that FocusUI surpasses GUI-specific baselines. On the ScreenSpot-Pro benchmark, FocusUI-7B achieves a performance improvement of 3.7% over GUI-Actor-7B. Even with only 30% visual token retention, FocusUI-7B drops by only 3.2% while achieving up to 1.44x faster inference and 17% lower peak GPU memory.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言模型(VLMs)在用户界面(UI)基准测试任务中表现出卓越的性能，这得益于它们处理越来越高分辨率截屏的能力。然而，截屏会被标记化成数千个视觉标记（例如，2K分辨率截屏大约有4700个），导致显著的计算开销并稀释注意力。相比之下，人类在与UI交互时通常专注于感兴趣的区域。在这项工作中，我们率先提出了高效的UI基准测试任务。基于对该任务特性和挑战的实际分析，我们提出了FocusUI，一种高效的UI基准测试框架，它选择与指令最相关的图块，同时保留位置连续性以实现精确的基准测试。FocusUI解决了两个关键挑战：（1）消除视觉编码中的冗余标记。我们通过融合指令条件得分和基于规则的UI图得分来构建图块级别的监督，从而降低大型同质区域的权重，以选择独特且与指令相关的视觉标记。（2）在视觉标记选择期间保持位置连续性。我们发现，通用的视觉标记剪枝方法由于破坏了位置信息，在UI基准测试任务中会遭受严重的精度下降。我们引入了一种新颖的PosPad策略，该策略将每个连续丢弃的视觉标记序列压缩为放置在序列最后一个索引位置的单个特殊标记，以保留位置连续性。在四个基准测试上的全面实验表明，FocusUI超越了特定于GUI的基线。在ScreenSpot-Pro基准测试上，FocusUI-7B的性能比GUI-Actor-7B提高了3.7%。即使仅保留30%的视觉标记，FocusUI-7B的性能也仅下降了3.2%，同时实现了高达1.44倍的更快推理速度和17%的更低峰值GPU内存占用。

Authors: Mingyu Ouyang, Kevin Qinghong Lin, Mike Zheng Shou, Hwee Tou Ng

Current Agents Fail to Leverage World Model as Tool for Foresight

简要说明：本文研究了当前智能体利用世界模型进行预测的能力，发现智能体在模拟调用、解释和整合方面存在不足，表明需要改进的机制以实现与世界模型的战略性互动。

TLDR: This paper investigates current agents' ability to effectively use world models for foresight, finding deficiencies in simulation invocation, interpretation, and integration, suggesting the need for improved mechanisms for strategic world model interaction.

Abstract: Agents built on vision-language models increasingly face tasks that demand anticipating future states rather than relying on short-horizon reasoning. Generative world models offer a promising remedy: agents could use them as external simulators to foresee outcomes before acting. This paper empirically examines whether current agents can leverage such world models as tools to enhance their cognition. Across diverse agentic and visual question answering tasks, we observe that some agents rarely invoke simulation (fewer than 1%), frequently misuse predicted rollouts (approximately 15%), and often exhibit inconsistent or even degraded performance (up to 5%) when simulation is available or enforced. Attribution analysis further indicates that the primary bottleneck lies in the agents' capacity to decide when to simulate, how to interpret predicted outcomes, and how to integrate foresight into downstream reasoning. These findings underscore the need for mechanisms that foster calibrated, strategic interaction with world models, paving the way toward more reliable anticipatory cognition in future agent systems.

摘要（中文）：基于视觉-语言模型构建的智能体越来越多地面临需要预测未来状态的任务，而非依赖于短时推理。生成式世界模型提供了一种有前景的解决方案：智能体可以使用它们作为外部模拟器来预测行动的结果。本文实证研究了当前的智能体是否能够利用这些世界模型作为工具来增强其认知能力。在各种智能体和视觉问答任务中，我们观察到一些智能体很少调用模拟（少于1%），经常误用预测的展开（约15%），并且在模拟可用或强制执行时，常常表现出不一致甚至下降的性能（高达5%）。归因分析进一步表明，主要瓶颈在于智能体决定何时进行模拟、如何解释预测结果以及如何将预测整合到下游推理中的能力。这些发现强调了对能够促进与世界模型进行校准的、战略性交互的机制的需求，从而为未来智能体系统中更可靠的预期认知铺平道路。

Authors: Cheng Qian, Emre Can Acikgoz, Bingxuan Li, Xiusi Chen, Yuji Zhang, Bingxiang He, Qinyu Luo, Dilek Hakkani-Tür, Gokhan Tur, Yunzhu Li, Heng Ji

Adaptive-Boundary-Clipping GRPO: Ensuring Bounded Ratios for Stable and Generalizable Training

简要说明：该论文介绍了自适应边界裁剪GRPO（ABC-GRPO），它是群体相对策略优化（GRPO）的一种改进变体，用于LLM的强化学习，在数学推理方面表现出卓越的性能，并在训练过程中保持更高的熵。

TLDR: The paper introduces Adaptive-Boundary-Clipping GRPO (ABC-GRPO), an improved variant of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) for reinforcement learning with LLMs, showing superior performance on mathematical reasoning and maintaining higher entropy during training.

Abstract: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) has emerged as a popular algorithm for reinforcement learning with large language models (LLMs). However, upon analyzing its clipping mechanism, we argue that it is suboptimal in certain scenarios. With appropriate modifications, GRPO can be significantly enhanced to improve both flexibility and generalization. To this end, we propose Adaptive-Boundary-Clipping GRPO (ABC-GRPO), an asymmetric and adaptive refinement of the original GRPO framework. We demonstrate that ABC-GRPO achieves superior performance over standard GRPO on mathematical reasoning tasks using the Qwen3 LLMs. Moreover, ABC-GRPO maintains substantially higher entropy throughout training, thereby preserving the model's exploration capacity and mitigating premature convergence. The implementation code is available online to ease reproducibility https://github.com/chi2liu/ABC-GRPO.

摘要（中文）：群体相对策略优化 (GRPO) 已经成为一种流行的基于大型语言模型 (LLM) 的强化学习算法。 然而，通过分析其裁剪机制，我们认为它在某些情况下并非最优。 通过适当的修改，GRPO 可以得到显著增强，从而提高灵活性和泛化性。 为此，我们提出自适应边界裁剪 GRPO (ABC-GRPO)，它是原始 GRPO 框架的非对称和自适应改进。 我们证明了在使用 Qwen3 LLM 的数学推理任务中，ABC-GRPO 比标准 GRPO 取得了更优越的性能。 此外，ABC-GRPO 在整个训练过程中保持了显著更高的熵，从而保留了模型的探索能力并缓解了过早收敛。 实现代码已在线提供，以便于重现 https://github.com/chi2liu/ABC-GRPO。

Authors: Chi Liu, Xin Chen

R$^3$L: Reflect-then-Retry Reinforcement Learning with Language-Guided Exploration, Pivotal Credit, and Positive Amplification

简要说明：该论文介绍了R$^3$L，一种强化学习方法，它利用语言反馈进行探索，并采用关键信用分配和积极放大，以提高在具有挑战性的智能体和推理任务中的性能。

TLDR: The paper introduces R$^3$L, a Reinforcement Learning method that uses language feedback for exploration and pivotal credit assignment with positive amplification to improve performance on challenging agentic and reasoning tasks.

Abstract: Reinforcement learning drives recent advances in LLM reasoning and agentic capabilities, yet current approaches struggle with both exploration and exploitation. Exploration suffers from low success rates on difficult tasks and high costs of repeated rollouts from scratch. Exploitation suffers from coarse credit assignment and training instability: Trajectory-level rewards penalize valid prefixes for later errors, and failure-dominated groups overwhelm the few positive signals, leaving optimization without constructive direction. To this end, we propose R$^3$L, Reflect-then-Retry Reinforcement Learning with Language-Guided Exploration, Pivotal Credit, and Positive Amplification. To synthesize high-quality trajectories, R$^3$L shifts from stochastic sampling to active synthesis via reflect-then-retry, leveraging language feedback to diagnose errors, transform failed attempts into successful ones, and reduce rollout costs by restarting from identified failure points. With errors diagnosed and localized, Pivotal Credit Assignment updates only the diverging suffix where contrastive signals exist, excluding the shared prefix from gradient update. Since failures dominate on difficult tasks and reflect-then-retry produces off-policy data, risking training instability, Positive Amplification upweights successful trajectories to ensure positive signals guide the optimization process. Experiments on agentic and reasoning tasks demonstrate 5\% to 52\% relative improvements over baselines while maintaining training stability. Our code is released at https://github.com/shiweijiezero/R3L.

摘要（中文）：强化学习推动了LLM推理和代理能力方面的最新进展，但现有方法在探索和利用方面都面临挑战。探索受到高难度任务成功率低以及从零开始重复试验带来的高成本所困扰。利用则受到粗糙的信用分配和训练不稳定性的影响：轨迹级别的奖励会因后续的错误而惩罚有效的前缀，而失败主导的群体会淹没少数积极信号，导致优化缺乏建设性方向。为此，我们提出了R$^3$L，即基于语言引导探索、关键性信用和正向增强的反射-重试强化学习。为了合成高质量的轨迹，R$^3$L从随机采样转向通过反射-重试进行主动合成，利用语言反馈来诊断错误，将失败的尝试转化为成功的尝试，并通过从确定的失败点重新启动来降低试验成本。在诊断并定位错误后，关键性信用分配仅更新存在对比信号的发散后缀，并将共享的前缀排除在梯度更新之外。由于失败在高难度任务中占据主导地位，且反射-重试会产生非策略数据，从而带来训练不稳定性的风险，因此正向增强会提高成功轨迹的权重，以确保积极信号引导优化过程。在代理和推理任务上的实验表明，与基线相比，相对改进幅度为5%至52%，同时保持了训练稳定性。我们的代码已在https://github.com/shiweijiezero/R3L上发布。

Authors: Weijie Shi, Yanxi Chen, Zexi Li, Xuchen Pan, Yuchang Sun, Jiajie Xu, Xiaofang Zhou, Yaliang Li

Towards Compositional Generalization of LLMs via Skill Taxonomy Guided Data Synthesis

简要说明：该论文介绍了一种名为STEPS的框架，通过使用技能分类法为LLM合成具有组合挑战性的数据，以提高指令遵循能力和基于代理的任务中的泛化能力，并且优于现有的基线方法。

TLDR: The paper introduces STEPS, a framework for synthesizing compositionally challenging data for LLMs by using a skill taxonomy to improve instruction-following and generalization in agent-based tasks, outperforming existing baselines.

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) and agent-based systems often struggle with compositional generalization due to a data bottleneck in which complex skill combinations follow a long-tailed, power-law distribution, limiting both instruction-following performance and generalization in agent-centric tasks. To address this challenge, we propose STEPS, a Skill Taxonomy guided Entropy-based Post-training data Synthesis framework for generating compositionally challenging data. STEPS explicitly targets compositional generalization by uncovering latent relationships among skills and organizing them into an interpretable, hierarchical skill taxonomy using structural information theory. Building on this taxonomy, we formulate data synthesis as a constrained information maximization problem, selecting skill combinations that maximize marginal structural information within the hierarchy while preserving semantic coherence. Experiments on challenging instruction-following benchmarks show that STEPS outperforms existing data synthesis baselines, while also yielding improved compositional generalization in downstream agent-based evaluations.

摘要（中文）：大型语言模型（LLMs）和基于Agent的系统通常在组合泛化方面存在困难，这主要是由于数据瓶颈所致，其中复杂技能组合遵循长尾的幂律分布，从而限制了指令跟随的性能和以Agent为中心任务中的泛化能力。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了STEPS，一种技能分类指导的基于熵的后训练数据合成框架，用于生成具有组合挑战性的数据。STEPS通过挖掘技能之间的潜在关系，并使用结构信息理论将其组织成一个可解释的层级技能分类，从而显式地针对组合泛化。在此分类的基础上，我们将数据合成公式化为一个受约束的信息最大化问题，选择最大化层级内部边缘结构信息的技能组合，同时保持语义一致性。在具有挑战性的指令跟随基准测试上的实验表明，STEPS优于现有的数据合成基线，同时在下游基于Agent的评估中也产生了改进的组合泛化能力。

Authors: Yifan Wei, Li Du, Xiaoyan Yu, Yang Feng, Angsheng Li

AMIR-GRPO: Inducing Implicit Preference Signals into GRPO

简要说明：AMIR-GRPO通过利用rollout组内奖励排名的隐式成对偏好信息改进了GRPO在LLM对齐推理任务中的表现，从而在数学推理基准测试中实现了更好的性能。

TLDR: AMIR-GRPO improves GRPO for LLM alignment in reasoning tasks by using implicit pairwise preference information from reward rankings within rollout groups, leading to improved performance on mathematical reasoning benchmarks.

Abstract: Reinforcement learning has become the primary paradigm for aligning large language models (LLMs) on complex reasoning tasks, with group relative policy optimization (GRPO) widely used in large-scale post-training. However, GRPO faces structural limitations in reasoning-heavy settings: sequence-level advantage normalization introduces systematic length bias, penalties for low-quality trajectories are diluted, and the scalar objective discards rich pairwise preference information embedded in within-group reward rankings. As a result, valuable supervision from costly rollouts remains underutilized. We propose AMIR-GRPO, which augments GRPO with an implicit DPO-style contrastive regularizer constructed directly from intra-group reward rankings, requiring no additional annotations. This mechanism amplifies suppression of low-reward trajectories, attenuates response-level length bias, and transforms each rollout group into a denser set of supervision constraints. Across multiple mathematical reasoning benchmarks, AMIR-GRPO consistently outperforms strong GRPO baselines, yields clearer separation between correct and incorrect reasoning chains, and delivers broader coverage gains beyond the subset of instances solved by standard GRPO.

摘要（中文）：强化学习已成为对齐大型语言模型（LLM）以解决复杂推理任务的主要范式，其中群体相对策略优化（GRPO）被广泛应用于大规模后训练中。然而，GRPO在重推理设置中面临结构性限制：序列级优势归一化引入了系统性的长度偏差，对低质量轨迹的惩罚被稀释，并且标量目标丢弃了蕴含在群体内部奖励排序中的丰富的成对偏好信息。因此，来自高成本 rollout 的有价值的监督信息仍未得到充分利用。 我们提出AMIR-GRPO，通过直接从群体内部奖励排序构建的隐式DPO风格对比正则化器来增强GRPO，无需额外的标注。这种机制放大了对低奖励轨迹的抑制，减弱了响应级的长度偏差，并将每个 rollout 群体转化为更密集的监督约束集合。在多个数学推理基准测试中，AMIR-GRPO始终优于强大的GRPO基线，产生了更清晰的正确和错误推理链分离，并实现了超出标准GRPO所解决实例子集的更广泛的覆盖增益。

Authors: Amir Hossein Yari, Fajri Koto

Policy-Guided Search on Tree-of-Thoughts for Efficient Problem Solving with Bounded Language Model Queries

简要说明：该论文介绍了一种策略引导搜索方法（Levin Tree Search，适用于Tree-of-Thoughts），它提高了在计算约束下基于语言模型的问题解决效率，并在多个领域中展示了更高的准确性。

TLDR: This paper introduces a policy-guided search method (Levin Tree Search adapted for Tree-of-Thoughts) that improves the efficiency of language model-based problem-solving under computational constraints, demonstrating improved accuracy across various domains.

Abstract: Recent studies explored integrating state-space search algorithms with Language Models (LM) to perform look-ahead on the token generation process, the ''Tree-of-Thoughts'' (ToT), generated by LMs, thereby improving performance on problem-solving tasks. However, the affiliated search algorithms often overlook the significant computational costs associated with LM inference, particularly in scenarios with constrained computational budgets. Consequently, we address the problem of improving LM performance on problem-solving tasks under limited computational budgets. We demonstrate how the probabilities assigned to thoughts by LMs can serve as a heuristic to guide search within the ToT framework, thereby reducing the number of thought evaluations. Building on this insight, we adapt a heuristic search algorithm, Levin Tree Search (LTS), to the ToT framework, which leverages LMs as policies to guide the tree exploration efficiently. We extend the theoretical results of LTS by showing that, for ToT (a pruned tree), LTS guarantees a bound on the number of states expanded, and consequently, on the number of thoughts generated. Additionally, we analyze the sensitivity of this bound to the temperature values commonly used in the final softmax layer of the LM. Empirical evaluation under a fixed LM query budget demonstrates that LTS consistently achieves comparable or higher accuracy than baseline search algorithms within the ToT framework, across three domains (Blocksworld, PrOntoQA, Array Sorting) and four distinct LMs. These findings highlight the efficacy of LTS on ToT, particularly in enabling cost-effective and time-efficient problem-solving, making it well-suited for latency-critical and resource-constrained applications.

摘要（中文）：近期研究探索了将状态空间搜索算法与语言模型(LM)结合，以对语言模型生成的"思维树"(ToT)的token生成过程进行前瞻，从而提高解决问题的性能。然而，相关的搜索算法常常忽视与LM推理相关的显著计算成本，尤其是在计算预算受限的情况下。因此，我们致力于在有限计算预算下提高LM在解决问题任务上的性能。我们证明了LM分配给思维的概率可以用作启发式算法来指导ToT框架内的搜索，从而减少思维评估的数量。基于这一洞察，我们将启发式搜索算法Levin树搜索(LTS)应用于ToT框架，该算法利用LM作为策略来有效地指导树的探索。我们扩展了LTS的理论结果，表明对于ToT(一个剪枝树)，LTS保证了扩展状态数量的界限，从而保证了生成的思维数量的界限。此外，我们分析了该界限对LM最终softmax层中常用的温度值的敏感性。在固定LM查询预算下的实证评估表明，在三个领域(Blocksworld, PrOntoQA, 数组排序)和四个不同的LM中，LTS始终在ToT框架内实现了与基线搜索算法相当或更高的准确率。这些发现突显了LTS在ToT上的有效性，特别是在实现具有成本效益和时间效率的问题解决方面，使其非常适合对延迟敏感和资源受限的应用。

Authors: Sumedh Pendurkar, Guni Sharon

Can LLMs See Without Pixels? Benchmarking Spatial Intelligence from Textual Descriptions

简要说明：本文介绍了SiT-Bench，一个用于评估LLM在没有视觉输入情况下的空间智能的新基准。研究揭示了一个“空间差距”，并强调了显式空间推理在提高LLM对具身智能体性能方面的潜力。

TLDR: This paper introduces SiT-Bench, a novel benchmark for evaluating spatial intelligence in LLMs without visual input, revealing a "spatial gap" and highlighting the potential of explicit spatial reasoning to improve LLM performance for embodied agents.

Abstract: Recent advancements in Spatial Intelligence (SI) have predominantly relied on Vision-Language Models (VLMs), yet a critical question remains: does spatial understanding originate from visual encoders or the fundamental reasoning backbone? Inspired by this question, we introduce SiT-Bench, a novel benchmark designed to evaluate the SI performance of Large Language Models (LLMs) without pixel-level input, comprises over 3,800 expert-annotated items across five primary categories and 17 subtasks, ranging from egocentric navigation and perspective transformation to fine-grained robotic manipulation. By converting single/multi-view scenes into high-fidelity, coordinate-aware textual descriptions, we challenge LLMs to perform symbolic textual reasoning rather than visual pattern matching. Evaluation results of state-of-the-art (SOTA) LLMs reveals that while models achieve proficiency in localized semantic tasks, a significant "spatial gap" remains in global consistency. Notably, we find that explicit spatial reasoning significantly boosts performance, suggesting that LLMs possess latent world-modeling potential. Our proposed dataset SiT-Bench serves as a foundational resource to foster the development of spatially-grounded LLM backbones for future VLMs and embodied agents. Our code and benchmark will be released at https://github.com/binisalegend/SiT-Bench .

摘要（中文）：空间智能(SI)领域的最新进展主要依赖于视觉-语言模型(VLM)，但仍存在一个关键问题：空间理解究竟源于视觉编码器还是根本性的推理主干？受此启发，我们推出了SiT-Bench，这是一个新颖的基准，旨在评估大型语言模型(LLM)在没有像素级输入情况下的SI性能。该基准包含超过3800个专家标注条目，涵盖五个主要类别和17个子任务，范围从以自我为中心的导航、透视变换到细粒度的机器人操作。通过将单/多视图场景转换为高保真、坐标感知的文本描述，我们挑战LLM进行符号化文本推理，而非视觉模式匹配。对当前最佳(SOTA) LLM的评估结果表明，虽然模型在局部语义任务中表现出色，但在全局一致性方面仍然存在显著的“空间差距”。值得注意的是，我们发现显式的空间推理能够显著提升性能，表明LLM具有潜在的世界建模能力。我们提出的数据集SiT-Bench可作为基础资源，以促进未来VLM和具身代理的空间定位LLM主干的开发。我们的代码和基准测试将在https://github.com/binisalegend/SiT-Bench发布。

Authors: Zhongbin Guo, Zhen Yang, Yushan Li, Xinyue Zhang, Wenyu Gao, Jiacheng Wang, Chengzhi Li, Xiangrui Liu, Ping Jian

SCRIBE: Structured Mid-Level Supervision for Tool-Using Language Models

简要说明：该论文介绍了SCRIBE，一个强化学习框架，它使用结构化的中层监督来改进工具增强的语言模型，通过为奖励建模提供精确的、特定于技能的准则，从而在工具使用基准测试中实现了最先进的性能。

TLDR: The paper introduces SCRIBE, a reinforcement learning framework using structured mid-level supervision to improve tool-augmented language models by providing precise, skill-specific rubrics for reward modeling, leading to state-of-the-art performance in tool-use benchmarks.

Abstract: Training reliable tool-augmented agents remains a significant challenge, largely due to the difficulty of credit assignment in multi-step reasoning. While process-level reward models offer a promising direction, existing LLM-based judges often produce noisy and inconsistent signals because they lack fine-grained, task-specific rubrics to distinguish high-level planning from low-level execution. In this work, we introduce SCRIBE (Skill-Conditioned Reward with Intermediate Behavioral Evaluation), a reinforcement learning framework that intervenes at a novel mid-level abstraction. SCRIBE grounds reward modeling in a curated library of skill prototypes, transforming open-ended LLM evaluation into a constrained verification problem. By routing each subgoal to a corresponding prototype, the reward model is equipped with precise, structured rubrics that substantially reduce reward variance. Experimental results show that SCRIBE achieves state-of-the-art performance across a range of reasoning and tool-use benchmarks. In particular, it improves the AIME25 accuracy of a Qwen3-4B model from 43.3% to 63.3%, and significantly increases success rates in complex multi-turn tool interactions. Further analysis of training dynamics reveals a co-evolution across abstraction levels, where mastery of mid-level skills consistently precedes the emergence of effective high-level planning behaviors. Finally, we demonstrate that SCRIBE is additive to low-level tool optimizations, providing a scalable and complementary pathway toward more autonomous and reliable tool-using agents.

摘要（中文）：训练可靠的工具增强型智能体仍然是一项重大挑战，这主要是由于多步推理中的信用分配非常困难。虽然过程级奖励模型提供了一个有前景的方向，但现有的基于LLM的裁判通常会产生噪声和不一致的信号，因为它们缺乏细粒度的、特定于任务的评价标准，以区分高层规划和低层执行。在这项工作中，我们提出了SCRIBE（技能条件奖励与中间行为评估），这是一个在一种新型的中层抽象层次上进行干预的强化学习框架。SCRIBE将奖励建模建立在精心策划的技能原型库的基础上，从而将开放式的LLM评估转化为一个受约束的验证问题。通过将每个子目标路由到相应的原型，奖励模型配备了精确的、结构化的评价标准，从而大大降低了奖励方差。 实验结果表明，SCRIBE在一系列推理和工具使用基准测试中均实现了最先进的性能。特别是，它将Qwen3-4B模型在AIME25上的准确率从43.3%提高到63.3%，并显著提高了复杂的多轮工具交互中的成功率。 对训练动态的进一步分析揭示了跨抽象层次的共同进化，其中对中层技能的掌握始终先于有效的高层规划行为的出现。最后，我们证明了SCRIBE可以叠加到低层工具优化上，从而为构建更自主和可靠的工具使用智能体提供了一种可扩展和互补的途径。

Authors: Yuxuan Jiang, Francis Ferraro

Mem-Gallery: Benchmarking Multimodal Long-Term Conversational Memory for MLLM Agents

简要说明：该论文介绍了 Mem-Gallery，这是一个用于评估 MLLM 智能体中多模态长期对话记忆的新基准，揭示了当前模型在记忆推理、知识管理和效率方面的局限性。

TLDR: The paper introduces Mem-Gallery, a new benchmark for evaluating multimodal long-term conversational memory in MLLM agents, revealing limitations in memory reasoning, knowledge management, and efficiency of current models.

Abstract: Long-term memory is a critical capability for multimodal large language model (MLLM) agents, particularly in conversational settings where information accumulates and evolves over time. However, existing benchmarks either evaluate multi-session memory in text-only conversations or assess multimodal understanding within localized contexts, failing to evaluate how multimodal memory is preserved, organized, and evolved across long-term conversational trajectories. Thus, we introduce Mem-Gallery, a new benchmark for evaluating multimodal long-term conversational memory in MLLM agents. Mem-Gallery features high-quality multi-session conversations grounded in both visual and textual information, with long interaction horizons and rich multimodal dependencies. Building on this dataset, we propose a systematic evaluation framework that assesses key memory capabilities along three functional dimensions: memory extraction and test-time adaptation, memory reasoning, and memory knowledge management. Extensive benchmarking across thirteen memory systems reveals several key findings, highlighting the necessity of explicit multimodal information retention and memory organization, the persistent limitations in memory reasoning and knowledge management, as well as the efficiency bottleneck of current models.

摘要（中文）：多模态大型语言模型（MLLM）代理的一个关键能力是长期记忆，尤其是在信息随时间积累和演变的对话环境中。然而，现有的基准测试要么评估纯文本对话中的多会话记忆，要么评估局部环境中的多模态理解，未能评估多模态记忆如何在长期对话轨迹中被保存、组织和演变。因此，我们引入了Mem-Gallery，这是一个新的基准，用于评估MLLM代理中的多模态长期对话记忆。Mem-Gallery具有基于视觉和文本信息的高质量多会话对话，具有较长的交互范围和丰富的多模态依赖关系。在此数据集的基础上，我们提出了一个系统的评估框架，该框架从三个功能维度评估关键的记忆能力：记忆提取和测试时适应、记忆推理以及记忆知识管理。对十三个记忆系统进行的大量基准测试揭示了几个关键发现，突出了显式多模态信息保留和记忆组织的重要性，记忆推理和知识管理方面存在的持续局限性，以及当前模型的效率瓶颈。

Authors: Yuanchen Bei, Tianxin Wei, Xuying Ning, Yanjun Zhao, Zhining Liu, Xiao Lin, Yada Zhu, Hendrik Hamann, Jingrui He, Hanghang Tong

Evolving Programmatic Skill Networks

简要说明：该论文介绍了程序化技能网络 (PSN)，一种利用大型语言模型在具身环境中持续获取技能的框架。它在 MineDojo 和 Crafter 上展示了技能重用、适应和泛化能力。

TLDR: The paper introduces Programmatic Skill Networks (PSN), a framework using LLMs for continual skill acquisition in embodied environments. It demonstrates skill reuse, adaptation, and generalization on MineDojo and Crafter.

Abstract: We study continual skill acquisition in open-ended embodied environments where an agent must construct, refine, and reuse an expanding library of executable skills. We introduce the Programmatic Skill Network (PSN), a framework in which skills are executable symbolic programs forming a compositional network that evolves through experience. PSN defines three core mechanisms instantiated via large language models: (1)REFLECT for structured fault localization over skill compositions, (2) progressive optimization with maturity-aware update gating that stabilizes reliable skills while maintaining plasticity for uncertain ones, and (3) canonical structural refactoring under rollback validation that maintains network compactness. We further show that PSN's learning dynamics exhibit structural parallels to neural network training. Experiments on MineDojo and Crafter demonstrate robust skill reuse, rapid adaptation, and strong generalization across open-ended task distributions.\footnote{We plan to open-source the code.

摘要（中文）：我们研究了在开放式具身环境中持续技能学习的问题，其中智能体必须构建、完善和复用一个不断扩展的可执行技能库。我们引入了程序化技能网络（PSN），一个技能是可执行符号程序并形成组合网络的框架，该网络通过经验不断演化。PSN定义了三个通过大型语言模型实例化的核心机制：（1） REFLECT，用于在技能组合中进行结构化的故障定位；（2）采用成熟度感知更新门限的渐进优化，以稳定可靠的技能，同时保持不确定技能的可塑性；（3）在回滚验证下的规范化结构重构，以保持网络的紧凑性。我们进一步证明了PSN的学习动态表现出与神经网络训练相似的结构。在MineDojo和Crafter上的实验表明，PSN在开放式任务分布中具有强大的技能复用、快速适应和泛化能力。\footnote{我们计划开源代码。

Authors: Haochen Shi, Xingdi Yuan, Bang Liu

SDCD: Structure-Disrupted Contrastive Decoding for Mitigating Hallucinations in Large Vision-Language Models

简要说明：该论文介绍了结构扰动对比解码 (SDCD)，这是一种无需训练的算法，通过解决视觉编码器包块行为产生的视觉统计偏差来减轻 LVLM 中的对象幻觉。

TLDR: This paper introduces Structure-Disrupted Contrastive Decoding (SDCD), a training-free algorithm to mitigate object hallucination in LVLMs by addressing visual statistical bias arising from the bag-of-patches behavior of vision encoders.

Abstract: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) demonstrate significant progress in multimodal understanding and reasoning, yet object hallucination remains a critical challenge. While existing research focuses on mitigating language priors or high-level statistical biases, they often overlook the internal complexities of the visual encoding process. We identify that visual statistical bias, arising from the inherent Bag-of-Patches behavior of Vision Encoders under weak structural supervision, acts as a contributing factor of object hallucinations. Under this bias, models prioritize local texture features within individual patches over holistic geometric structures. This tendency may induce spurious visual confidence and result in hallucinations. To address this, we introduce a training-free algorithm called Structure-Disrupted Contrastive Decoding (SDCD), which performs contrastive calibration of the output distribution by introducing a shuffled structure-disrupted view. By penalizing tokens that maintain high confidence under this structure-less view, SDCD effectively suppresses the texture-driven bias. Experimental results demonstrate that SDCD significantly mitigates hallucinations across multiple benchmarks and enhances the overall multimodal capabilities of LVLMs.

摘要（中文）：大型视觉-语言模型（LVLMs）在多模态理解和推理方面取得了显著进展，但物体幻觉仍然是一个关键挑战。 现有研究侧重于缓解语言先验或高层统计偏差，但往往忽略了视觉编码过程的内部复杂性。 我们发现，视觉统计偏差——源于视觉编码器在弱结构监督下的固有词袋（Bag-of-Patches）行为——是物体幻觉的一个促成因素。 在此偏差下，模型将局部纹理特征置于单个图像块内，而非整体几何结构之上。 这种倾向可能诱发虚假的视觉置信度，导致幻觉。 为了解决这个问题，我们引入了一种无需训练的算法，名为结构扰乱对比解码（SDCD），它通过引入一个洗牌的、结构扰乱的视图，对输出分布执行对比校准。 通过惩罚在结构缺失视图下仍保持高置信度的令牌，SDCD有效地抑制了纹理驱动的偏差。 实验结果表明，SDCD显著减轻了多个基准测试中的幻觉，并增强了LVLMs的整体多模态能力。

Authors: Yuxuan Xia, Siheng Wang, Peng Li

FROST-Drive: Scalable and Efficient End-to-End Driving with a Frozen Vision Encoder

简要说明：该论文介绍了FROST-Drive，一种端到端驾驶模型，利用冻结的视觉编码器（预训练于视觉语言模型）并展示了在Waymo Open E2E 数据集上比微调方法更好的泛化能力。

TLDR: The paper introduces FROST-Drive, an end-to-end driving model that leverages a frozen vision encoder pretrained on VLMs and demonstrates improved generalization on the Waymo Open E2E Dataset compared to fine-tuning approaches.

Abstract: End-to-end (E2E) models in autonomous driving aim to directly map sensor inputs to control commands, but their ability to generalize to novel and complex scenarios remains a key challenge. The common practice of fully fine-tuning the vision encoder on driving datasets potentially limits its generalization by causing the model to specialize too heavily in the training data. This work challenges the necessity of this training paradigm. We propose FROST-Drive, a novel E2E architecture designed to preserve and leverage the powerful generalization capabilities of a pretrained vision encoder from a Vision-Language Model (VLM). By keeping the encoder's weights frozen, our approach directly transfers the rich, generalized world knowledge from the VLM to the driving task. Our model architecture combines this frozen encoder with a transformer-based adapter for multimodal fusion and a GRU-based decoder for smooth waypoint generation. Furthermore, we introduce a custom loss function designed to directly optimize for Rater Feedback Score (RFS), a metric that prioritizes robust trajectory planning. We conduct extensive experiments on Waymo Open E2E Dataset, a large-scale datasets deliberately curated to capture the long-tail scenarios, demonstrating that our frozen-encoder approach significantly outperforms models that employ full fine-tuning. Our results provide substantial evidence that preserving the broad knowledge of a capable VLM is a more effective strategy for achieving robust, generalizable driving performance than intensive domain-specific adaptation. This offers a new pathway for developing vision-based models that can better handle the complexities of real-world application domains.

摘要（中文）：自动驾驶中的端到端（E2E）模型旨在直接将传感器输入映射到控制指令，但它们泛化到新颖且复杂场景的能力仍是一个关键挑战。在驾驶数据集上完全微调视觉编码器的常见做法可能会限制其泛化能力，因为这会导致模型过度专门化于训练数据。本文对这种训练范式的必要性提出了质疑。我们提出了FROST-Drive，一种新型E2E架构，旨在保持并利用来自视觉-语言模型（VLM）的预训练视觉编码器的强大泛化能力。通过保持编码器的权重冻结，我们的方法将VLM中丰富的、普遍的常识知识直接转移到驾驶任务中。我们的模型架构将这个冻结的编码器与一个基于Transformer的适配器相结合，用于多模态融合，并与一个基于GRU的解码器相结合，用于平滑航路点生成。此外，我们引入了一个定制的损失函数，旨在直接优化评估者反馈得分（RFS），这是一个优先考虑鲁棒轨迹规划的指标。我们在Waymo Open E2E数据集（一个经过精心设计以捕获长尾场景的大规模数据集）上进行了广泛的实验，证明了我们的冻结编码器方法显著优于采用完全微调的模型。我们的结果提供了充分的证据，表明保持有能力的VLM的广泛知识，比进行密集的特定领域适应，是实现稳健、可泛化的驾驶性能的更有效策略。这为开发能够更好地处理现实世界应用领域复杂性的基于视觉的模型提供了新的途径。

Authors: Zeyu Dong, Yimin Zhu, Yu Wu, Yu Sun

MAGMA: A Multi-Graph based Agentic Memory Architecture for AI Agents

简要说明：MAGMA是一种新颖的LLM内存架构，它利用多个图（语义、时间、因果、实体）进行查询自适应检索，从而提高长时程推理能力。它超越了最先进的代理记忆系统。

TLDR: MAGMA is a novel memory architecture for LLMs that utilizes multiple graphs (semantic, temporal, causal, entity) for query-adaptive retrieval, improving long-horizon reasoning. It surpasses state-of-the-art agentic memory systems.

Abstract: Memory-Augmented Generation (MAG) extends Large Language Models with external memory to support long-context reasoning, but existing approaches largely rely on semantic similarity over monolithic memory stores, entangling temporal, causal, and entity information. This design limits interpretability and alignment between query intent and retrieved evidence, leading to suboptimal reasoning accuracy. In this paper, we propose MAGMA, a multi-graph agentic memory architecture that represents each memory item across orthogonal semantic, temporal, causal, and entity graphs. MAGMA formulates retrieval as policy-guided traversal over these relational views, enabling query-adaptive selection and structured context construction. By decoupling memory representation from retrieval logic, MAGMA provides transparent reasoning paths and fine-grained control over retrieval. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval demonstrate that MAGMA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art agentic memory systems in long-horizon reasoning tasks.

摘要（中文）：基于记忆增强的生成（MAG）通过外部记忆扩展大型语言模型，以支持长上下文推理，但现有方法主要依赖于对单片记忆存储的语义相似性，将时间、因果和实体信息纠缠在一起。 这种设计限制了解释性以及查询意图和检索到的证据之间的对齐，导致次优的推理准确性。 在本文中，我们提出了 MAGMA，一种多图代理记忆架构，它通过正交的语义、时间、因果和实体图表示每个记忆项目。 MAGMA 将检索公式化为策略引导的遍历这些关系视图，从而实现查询自适应选择和结构化上下文构建。 通过将记忆表示与检索逻辑分离，MAGMA 提供了透明的推理路径和对检索的细粒度控制。 在 LoCoMo 和 LongMemEval 上的实验表明，MAGMA 在长程推理任务中始终优于最先进的代理记忆系统。

Authors: Dongming Jiang, Yi Li, Guanpeng Li, Bingzhe Li

GeoReason: Aligning Thinking And Answering In Remote Sensing Vision-Language Models Via Logical Consistency Reinforcement Learning

简要说明：本文介绍了GeoReason，一个使用强化学习来提高遥感视觉语言模型逻辑一致性的框架，解决逻辑幻觉和不可靠空间推理的问题。

TLDR: The paper introduces GeoReason, a framework using reinforcement learning to improve the logical consistency of Remote Sensing Vision-Language Models, addressing issues of logical hallucinations and unreliable spatial reasoning.

Abstract: The evolution of Remote Sensing Vision-Language Models(RS-VLMs) emphasizes the importance of transitioning from perception-centric recognition toward high-level deductive reasoning to enhance cognitive reliability in complex spatial tasks. However, current models often suffer from logical hallucinations, where correct answers are derived from flawed reasoning chains or rely on positional shortcuts rather than spatial logic. This decoupling undermines reliability in strategic spatial decision-making. To address this, we present GeoReason, a framework designed to synchronize internal thinking with final decisions. We first construct GeoReason-Bench, a logic-driven dataset containing 4,000 reasoning trajectories synthesized from geometric primitives and expert knowledge. We then formulate a two-stage training strategy: (1) Supervised Knowledge Initialization to equip the model with reasoning syntax and domain expertise, and (2) Consistency-Aware Reinforcement Learning to refine deductive reliability. This second stage integrates a novel Logical Consistency Reward, which penalizes logical drift via an option permutation strategy to anchor decisions in verifiable reasoning traces. Experimental results demonstrate that our framework significantly enhances the cognitive reliability and interpretability of RS-VLMs, achieving state-of-the-art performance compared to other advanced methods.

摘要（中文）：遥感视觉-语言模型(RS-VLMs)的发展强调了从以感知为中心的识别向高层次演绎推理过渡的重要性，以增强复杂空间任务中的认知可靠性。然而，当前的模型经常遭受逻辑幻觉的困扰，即从有缺陷的推理链中得出正确的答案，或者依赖于位置捷径而非空间逻辑。这种脱节削弱了战略性空间决策中的可靠性。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了GeoReason，一个旨在同步内部思考与最终决策的框架。我们首先构建GeoReason-Bench，一个逻辑驱动的数据集，包含从几何基元和专家知识中合成的4000条推理轨迹。然后，我们制定了一个两阶段的训练策略：（1）监督知识初始化，使模型具备推理语法和领域专业知识，以及（2）一致性感知强化学习，以提高演绎可靠性。第二阶段整合了一种新的逻辑一致性奖励，通过选项排列策略惩罚逻辑漂移，从而将决策锚定在可验证的推理轨迹中。实验结果表明，我们的框架显著提高了RS-VLMs的认知可靠性和可解释性，与其它先进方法相比，实现了最先进的性能。

Authors: Wenshuai Li, Xiantai Xiang, Zixiao Wen, Guangyao Zhou, Ben Niu, Feng Wang, Lijia Huang, Qiantong Wang, Yuxin Hu

TIR-Flow: Active Video Search and Reasoning with Frozen VLMs

简要说明：该论文介绍了TIR-Flow，一种通过假设分解、主动感知和持久工作空间利用来增强冻结视频-LLM推理能力的新框架，从而在多个基准测试中实现了显著的性能提升，通过主动视频搜索和推理来解决现有Video-LLMs推理能力不足的问题。

TLDR: The paper introduces TIR-Flow, a novel framework that enhances the reasoning capabilities of frozen Video-LLMs by enabling active video searching and reasoning through hypothesis decomposition, active perception, and persistent workspace utilization, achieving significant performance improvements on multiple benchmarks.

Abstract: While Large Video-Language Models (Video-LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in perception, their reasoning capabilities remain a bottleneck. Existing solutions typically resort to a heavy "data engineering" paradigm-synthesizing large-scale Chain-of-Thought (CoT) datasets followed by Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning (RL). This pipeline primarily optimizes probability sampling efficiency and aligns output distributions, but fails to activate the intrinsic intelligence required for dynamic visual exploration. In this work, we propose TIR-Flow, a novel framework that shifts the paradigm from passive processing to active video searching and reasoning without additional data or parameter updating. Concretely, our framework operates through three synergistic modules: HDD decomposes complex queries into a set of verifiable sub-tasks; HAP actively directs visual attention to gather high-resolution evidence for hypothesis validation; EBA maintains a persistent workspace to accumulate and update the discovered clues for logical reasoning. Extensive experiments on seven benchmarks demonstrate that TIR-Flow significantly outperforms recent strong baselines, delivering an average performance boost of 5.9%, with gains reaching 10.5% on Egoschema. Our analysis confirms that empowering frozen VLMs with System-2-like active perception is a scalable path toward solving long-horizon video reasoning.

摘要（中文）：大型视频语言模型（Video-LLMs）在感知方面取得了显著进展，但其推理能力仍是一个瓶颈。现有的解决方案通常采用一种繁重的“数据工程”范式——合成大规模思维链（CoT）数据集，然后进行监督式微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）。该流程主要优化概率抽样效率并对齐输出分布，但未能激活动态视觉探索所需的内在智能。在这项工作中，我们提出了TIR-Flow，一种新颖的框架，将范式从被动处理转变为主动视频搜索和推理，而无需额外的数据或参数更新。具体来说，我们的框架通过三个协同模块运行：HDD将复杂查询分解为一组可验证的子任务；HAP主动引导视觉注意力，以收集用于假设验证的高分辨率证据；EBA维护一个持久的工作空间，以积累和更新发现的线索，从而进行逻辑推理。在七个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，TIR-Flow显著优于最近的强大基线，平均性能提升了5.9%，在Egoschema上更是达到了10.5%。我们的分析证实，为冻结的VLM配备类似系统2的主动感知能力，是解决长时程视频推理的一种可扩展途径。

Authors: Hongbo Jin, Siyi Xie, Jiayu Ding, Kuanwei Lin, Ge Li

MVP: Enhancing Video Large Language Models via Self-supervised Masked Video Prediction

简要说明：该论文介绍了掩码视频预测 (MVP) 作为 VideoLLM 的后训练目标，通过重建掩码视频片段来提高其时间一致性和因果理解，从而增强视频推理能力。

TLDR: The paper introduces Masked Video Prediction (MVP) as a post-training objective for VideoLLMs to improve their temporal coherence and causal understanding by reconstructing masked video segments, enhancing video reasoning capabilities.

Abstract: Reinforcement learning based post-training paradigms for Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) have achieved significant success by optimizing for visual-semantic tasks such as captioning or VideoQA. However, while these approaches effectively enhance perception abilities, they primarily target holistic content understanding, often lacking explicit supervision for intrinsic temporal coherence and inter-frame correlations. This tendency limits the models' ability to capture intricate dynamics and fine-grained visual causality. To explicitly bridge this gap, we propose a novel post-training objective: Masked Video Prediction (MVP). By requiring the model to reconstruct a masked continuous segment from a set of challenging distractors, MVP forces the model to attend to the sequential logic and temporal context of events. To support scalable training, we introduce a scalable data synthesis pipeline capable of transforming arbitrary video corpora into MVP training samples, and further employ Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with a fine-grained reward function to enhance the model's understanding of video context and temporal properties. Comprehensive evaluations demonstrate that MVP enhances video reasoning capabilities by directly reinforcing temporal reasoning and causal understanding.

摘要（中文）：基于强化学习的视频大语言模型（VideoLLMs）后训练范式，通过优化视觉-语义任务（如视频字幕生成或视频问答），已取得了显著的成功。然而，尽管这些方法有效地增强了感知能力，但它们主要针对整体内容理解，通常缺乏对内在时间连贯性和帧间相关性的显式监督。这种倾向限制了模型捕获复杂动态和细粒度视觉因果关系的能力。为了明确弥合这一差距，我们提出了一种新的后训练目标：掩码视频预测（MVP）。通过要求模型从一组具有挑战性的干扰项中重建被掩盖的连续片段，MVP迫使模型关注事件的顺序逻辑和时间上下文。为了支持可扩展的训练，我们引入了一个可扩展的数据合成流程，能够将任意视频语料库转换为 MVP 训练样本，并进一步采用具有细粒度奖励函数的群体相对策略优化（GRPO），以增强模型对视频上下文和时间属性的理解。全面的评估表明，MVP 通过直接加强时间推理和因果理解，提升了视频推理能力。

Authors: Xiaokun Sun, Zezhong Wu, Zewen Ding, Linli Xu

I2E: From Image Pixels to Actionable Interactive Environments for Text-Guided Image Editing

简要说明：该论文介绍了I2E，一种新的文本引导图像编辑范式，它将图像分解为可操作的对象层，并使用视觉-语言-动作代理根据复杂的指令执行编辑，从而解决了像素级图像修复方法的局限性。

TLDR: The paper introduces I2E, a new paradigm for text-guided image editing that decomposes images into manipulable object layers and uses a Vision-Language-Action Agent to perform edits based on complex instructions, addressing limitations of pixel-level inpainting methods.

Abstract: Existing text-guided image editing methods primarily rely on end-to-end pixel-level inpainting paradigm. Despite its success in simple scenarios, this paradigm still significantly struggles with compositional editing tasks that require precise local control and complex multi-object spatial reasoning. This paradigm is severely limited by 1) the implicit coupling of planning and execution, 2) the lack of object-level control granularity, and 3) the reliance on unstructured, pixel-centric modeling. To address these limitations, we propose I2E, a novel "Decompose-then-Action" paradigm that revisits image editing as an actionable interaction process within a structured environment. I2E utilizes a Decomposer to transform unstructured images into discrete, manipulable object layers and then introduces a physics-aware Vision-Language-Action Agent to parse complex instructions into a series of atomic actions via Chain-of-Thought reasoning. Further, we also construct I2E-Bench, a benchmark designed for multi-instance spatial reasoning and high-precision editing. Experimental results on I2E-Bench and multiple public benchmarks demonstrate that I2E significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in handling complex compositional instructions, maintaining physical plausibility, and ensuring multi-turn editing stability.

摘要（中文）：现有文本引导的图像编辑方法主要依赖于端到端的像素级图像修复范式。尽管这种范式在简单场景中取得了成功，但在需要精确局部控制和复杂多对象空间推理的组合编辑任务中仍然面临显著挑战。这种范式受到以下因素的严重限制：1) 规划和执行的隐式耦合，2) 缺乏对象级别的控制粒度，以及 3) 依赖于非结构化的、以像素为中心的建模。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种新颖的“分解-然后-行动”范式 I2E，它将图像编辑重新审视为结构化环境中可操作的交互过程。I2E 利用一个分解器将非结构化图像转换为离散的、可操作的对象层，然后引入一个具有物理感知能力的视觉-语言-行动智能体，通过思维链推理将复杂的指令解析为一系列原子动作。 此外，我们还构建了 I2E-Bench，这是一个专为多实例空间推理和高精度编辑设计的基准。在 I2E-Bench 和多个公共基准上的实验结果表明，I2E 在处理复杂的组合指令、保持物理合理性以及确保多轮编辑稳定性方面显著优于最先进的方法。

Authors: Jinghan Yu, Junhao Xiao, Chenyu Zhu, Jiaming Li, Jia Li, HanMing Deng, Xirui Wang, Guoli Jia, Jianjun Li, Zhiyuan Ma, Xiang Bai, Bowen Zhou

BREATH-VL: Vision-Language-Guided 6-DoF Bronchoscopy Localization via Semantic-Geometric Fusion

简要说明：该论文介绍了BREATH-VL，一个用于6自由度支气管镜定位的视觉语言引导框架，以及BREATH数据集。该框架通过融合语义和几何信息，以及使用轻量级的时间上下文学习机制，解决了将视觉语言模型应用于内窥镜姿态估计的挑战。

TLDR: The paper introduces BREATH-VL, a vision-language-guided framework for 6-DoF bronchoscopy localization, along with the BREATH dataset, addressing challenges in applying VLMs to endoscopic pose estimation by fusing semantic and geometric information and using a lightweight temporal context learning mechanism.

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have recently shown remarkable performance in navigation and localization tasks by leveraging large-scale pretraining for semantic understanding. However, applying VLMs to 6-DoF endoscopic camera localization presents several challenges: 1) the lack of large-scale, high-quality, densely annotated, and localization-oriented vision-language datasets in real-world medical settings; 2) limited capability for fine-grained pose regression; and 3) high computational latency when extracting temporal features from past frames. To address these issues, we first construct BREATH dataset, the largest in-vivo endoscopic localization dataset to date, collected in the complex human airway. Building on this dataset, we propose BREATH-VL, a hybrid framework that integrates semantic cues from VLMs with geometric information from vision-based registration methods for accurate 6-DoF pose estimation. Our motivation lies in the complementary strengths of both approaches: VLMs offer generalizable semantic understanding, while registration methods provide precise geometric alignment. To further enhance the VLM's ability to capture temporal context, we introduce a lightweight context-learning mechanism that encodes motion history as linguistic prompts, enabling efficient temporal reasoning without expensive video-level computation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that the vision-language module delivers robust semantic localization in challenging surgical scenes. Building on this, our BREATH-VL outperforms state-of-the-art vision-only localization methods in both accuracy and generalization, reducing translational error by 25.5% compared with the best-performing baseline, while achieving competitive computational latency.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言模型 (VLMs) 近来在导航和定位任务中表现出卓越的性能，这得益于大规模的预训练对语义理解的提升。然而，将 VLMs 应用于 6-DoF 内窥镜相机定位面临着多个挑战：1) 缺乏现实世界医疗环境中大规模、高质量、密集标注且面向定位的视觉-语言数据集；2) 精细姿态回归的能力有限；以及 3) 从过去帧中提取时间特征时存在较高的计算延迟。为了解决这些问题，我们首先构建了迄今为止最大的体内内窥镜定位数据集 BREATH 数据集，该数据集是在复杂的人体气道中收集的。在此数据集的基础上，我们提出了一种混合框架 BREATH-VL，该框架集成了来自 VLMs 的语义线索和来自基于视觉的配准方法的几何信息，以实现精确的 6-DoF 姿态估计。我们的动机在于这两种方法的互补优势：VLMs 提供可泛化的语义理解，而配准方法提供精确的几何对齐。为了进一步提升 VLM 捕捉时间上下文的能力，我们引入了一种轻量级的上下文学习机制，将运动历史编码为语言提示，从而实现高效的时间推理，而无需昂贵的视频级计算。 广泛的实验表明，视觉-语言模块在具有挑战性的手术场景中提供了稳健的语义定位。 在此基础上，我们的 BREATH-VL 在准确性和泛化性方面均优于最先进的纯视觉定位方法，与性能最佳的基线相比，平移误差降低了 25.5%，同时实现了具有竞争力的计算延迟。

Authors: Qingyao Tian, Bingyu Yang, Huai Liao, Xinyan Huang, Junyong Li, Dong Yi, Hongbin Liu

SpatiaLoc: Leveraging Multi-Level Spatial Enhanced Descriptors for Cross-Modal Localization

简要说明：该论文介绍了SpatiaLoc，一个用于文本和点云跨模态定位的新框架，利用多层次空间关系，采用由粗到精的策略，在KITTI360Pose上优于现有的SOTA方法。

TLDR: The paper introduces SpatiaLoc, a novel framework for cross-modal localization using text and point clouds, leveraging multi-level spatial relationships with a coarse-to-fine strategy that outperforms SOTA methods on KITTI360Pose.

Abstract: Cross-modal localization using text and point clouds enables robots to localize themselves via natural language descriptions, with applications in autonomous navigation and interaction between humans and robots. In this task, objects often recur across text and point clouds, making spatial relationships the most discriminative cues for localization. Given this characteristic, we present SpatiaLoc, a framework utilizing a coarse-to-fine strategy that emphasizes spatial relationships at both the instance and global levels. In the coarse stage, we introduce a Bezier Enhanced Object Spatial Encoder (BEOSE) that models spatial relationships at the instance level using quadratic Bezier curves. Additionally, a Frequency Aware Encoder (FAE) generates spatial representations in the frequency domain at the global level. In the fine stage, an Uncertainty Aware Gaussian Fine Localizer (UGFL) regresses 2D positions by modeling predictions as Gaussian distributions with a loss function aware of uncertainty. Extensive experiments on KITTI360Pose demonstrate that SpatiaLoc significantly outperforms existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods.

摘要（中文）：使用文本和点云进行跨模态定位使机器人能够通过自然语言描述进行自定位，从而应用于自主导航以及人与机器人之间的交互。在该任务中，物体经常在文本和点云中重复出现，这使得空间关系成为定位最具区分性的线索。 鉴于这一特性，我们提出SpatiaLoc，一个利用粗到细策略的框架，该框架在实例和全局层面上都强调空间关系。 在粗略阶段，我们引入了Bezier增强物体空间编码器（BEOSE），它使用二次Bezier曲线在实例层面建模空间关系。此外，频率感知编码器（FAE）在全局层面在频域中生成空间表示。 在精细阶段，不确定性感知高斯精细定位器（UGFL）通过将预测建模为具有不确定性感知损失函数的高斯分布来回归2D位置。 在KITTI360Pose上的大量实验表明，SpatiaLoc显著优于现有的最先进（SOTA）方法。
