Authors: Tianyi Shang, Pengjie Xu, Zhaojun Deng, Zhenyu Li, Zhicong Chen, Lijun Wu

Semantic Belief-State World Model for 3D Human Motion Prediction

简要说明：本文介绍了一种用于人体运动预测的语义信念状态世界模型（SBWM），该模型在人体流形上使用潜在的动力学模拟，并优先考虑稳定的前向模拟而非重建保真度，从而实现更连贯的长期预测。

TLDR: This paper introduces a Semantic Belief-State World Model (SBWM) for human motion prediction, which uses a latent dynamical simulation on the human body manifold and prioritizes stable forward simulation over reconstruction fidelity, leading to more coherent long-horizon predictions.

Abstract: Human motion prediction has traditionally been framed as a sequence regression problem where models extrapolate future joint coordinates from observed pose histories. While effective over short horizons this approach does not separate observation reconstruction with dynamics modeling and offers no explicit representation of the latent causes governing motion. As a result, existing methods exhibit compounding drift, mean-pose collapse, and poorly calibrated uncertainty when rolled forward beyond the training regime. Here we propose a Semantic Belief-State World Model (SBWM) that reframes human motion prediction as latent dynamical simulation on the human body manifold. Rather than predicting poses directly, SBWM maintains a recurrent probabilistic belief state whose evolution is learned independently of pose reconstruction and explicitly aligned with the SMPL-X anatomical parameterization. This alignment imposes a structural information bottleneck that prevents the latent state from encoding static geometry or sensor noise, forcing it to capture motion dynamics, intent, and control-relevant structure. Inspired by belief-state world models developed for model-based reinforcement learning, SBWM adapts stochastic latent transitions and rollout-centric training to the domain of human motion. In contrast to RSSM-based, transformer, and diffusion approaches optimized for reconstruction fidelity, SBWM prioritizes stable forward simulation. We demonstrate coherent long-horizon rollouts, and competitive accuracy at substantially lower computational cost. These results suggest that treating the human body as part of the world models state space rather than its output fundamentally changes how motion is simulated, and predicted.

摘要（中文）：人体运动预测传统上被定义为序列回归问题，即模型从观察到的姿势历史中推断未来的关节坐标。虽然这种方法在短时间内有效，但它没有将观测重建与动态建模分离，并且没有对控制运动的潜在原因进行明确表示。因此，现有方法在超出训练范围之外进行推演时，会表现出累积漂移、均值姿势坍塌和不确定性校准不良等问题。在此，我们提出了一种语义信念状态世界模型（SBWM），它将人体运动预测重新定义为在人体流形上的潜在动态模拟。SBWM不是直接预测姿势，而是维护一个循环概率信念状态，其演化是独立于姿势重建学习的，并与SMPL-X解剖参数化显式对齐。这种对齐施加了一个结构性信息瓶颈，阻止了潜在状态编码静态几何或传感器噪声，迫使其捕获运动动力学、意图和控制相关的结构。受到为基于模型的强化学习开发的信念状态世界模型的启发，SBWM将随机潜在转移和以推演为中心的训练应用于人体运动领域。与为重建保真度优化的基于RSSM、Transformer和扩散的方法不同，SBWM优先考虑稳定的前向模拟。我们展示了连贯的长期推演，以及具有竞争力的准确性，同时计算成本大大降低。这些结果表明，将人体视为世界模型状态空间的一部分，而不是其输出，从根本上改变了运动的模拟和预测方式。

Authors: Sarim Chaudhry

Understanding Reward Hacking in Text-to-Image Reinforcement Learning

简要说明：本文分析了文本到图像强化学习中的奖励黑客行为，发现了一种常见的artifact易发图像的失败模式，并提出了一种轻量级的artifact奖励模型，用于规范现有的RL流程。

TLDR: This paper analyzes reward hacking in text-to-image reinforcement learning, identifies a common failure mode of artifact-prone images, and proposes a lightweight artifact reward model to regularize existing RL pipelines.

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a standard approach for post-training large language models and, more recently, for improving image generation models, which uses reward functions to enhance generation quality and human preference alignment. However, existing reward designs are often imperfect proxies for true human judgment, making models prone to reward hacking--producing unrealistic or low-quality images that nevertheless achieve high reward scores. In this work, we systematically analyze reward hacking behaviors in text-to-image (T2I) RL post-training. We investigate how both aesthetic/human preference rewards and prompt-image consistency rewards individually contribute to reward hacking and further show that ensembling multiple rewards can only partially mitigate this issue. Across diverse reward models, we identify a common failure mode: the generation of artifact-prone images. To address this, we propose a lightweight and adaptive artifact reward model, trained on a small curated dataset of artifact-free and artifact-containing samples. This model can be integrated into existing RL pipelines as an effective regularizer for commonly used reward models. Experiments demonstrate that incorporating our artifact reward significantly improves visual realism and reduces reward hacking across multiple T2I RL setups, demonstrating the effectiveness of lightweight reward augment serving as a safeguard against reward hacking.

摘要（中文）：强化学习（RL）已成为对大型语言模型进行后训练的标准方法，并且最近也被用于改进图像生成模型，它利用奖励函数来提高生成质量和与人类偏好的对齐。然而，现有的奖励设计往往是人类真实判断的不完美代理，这使得模型容易出现奖励破解——产生不真实或低质量的图像，但却能获得很高的奖励分数。在这项工作中，我们系统地分析了文本到图像（T2I）RL后训练中的奖励破解行为。我们研究了美学/人类偏好奖励和提示-图像一致性奖励如何分别导致奖励破解，并进一步表明，集成多个奖励只能部分缓解这个问题。在不同的奖励模型中，我们识别出一个常见的失效模式：容易生成包含伪影的图像。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种轻量级且自适应的伪影奖励模型，该模型在一小部分精选的无伪影和含伪影样本数据集上进行训练。该模型可以作为常用的奖励模型的有效正则化项，集成到现有的RL流程中。实验表明，将我们的伪影奖励纳入其中可以显著提高视觉逼真度，并减少多种T2I RL设置中的奖励破解，证明了轻量级奖励增强作为防止奖励破解的保障的有效性。

Authors: Yunqi Hong, Kuei-Chun Kao, Hengguang Zhou, Cho-Jui Hsieh

ThinkRL-Edit: Thinking in Reinforcement Learning for Reasoning-Centric Image Editing

简要说明：该论文介绍了 ThinkRL-Edit，一个强化学习框架，通过使用思维链（Chain-of-Thought）推理、无偏链偏好分组和二元清单奖励定义，专注于提高指令驱动图像编辑中的推理能力。

TLDR: The paper introduces ThinkRL-Edit, a reinforcement learning framework that focuses on improving reasoning in instruction-driven image editing by using Chain-of-Thought reasoning, unbiased chain preference grouping, and a binary checklist for reward definition.

Abstract: Instruction-driven image editing with unified multimodal generative models has advanced rapidly, yet their underlying visual reasoning remains limited, leading to suboptimal performance on reasoning-centric edits. Reinforcement learning (RL) has been investigated for improving the quality of image editing, but it faces three key challenges: (1) limited reasoning exploration confined to denoising stochasticity, (2) biased reward fusion, and (3) unstable VLM-based instruction rewards. In this work, we propose ThinkRL-Edit, a reasoning-centric RL framework that decouples visual reasoning from image synthesis and expands reasoning exploration beyond denoising. To the end, we introduce Chain-of-Thought (CoT)-based reasoning sampling with planning and reflection stages prior to generation in online sampling, compelling the model to explore multiple semantic hypotheses and validate their plausibility before committing to a visual outcome. To avoid the failures of weighted aggregation, we propose an unbiased chain preference grouping strategy across multiple reward dimensions. Moreover, we replace interval-based VLM scores with a binary checklist, yielding more precise, lower-variance, and interpretable rewards for complex reasoning. Experiments show our method significantly outperforms prior work on reasoning-centric image editing, producing instruction-faithful, visually coherent, and semantically grounded edits.

摘要（中文）：借助统一多模态生成模型的指令驱动图像编辑技术发展迅速，但其潜在的视觉推理能力仍然有限，导致以推理为中心的编辑任务表现欠佳。 强化学习（RL）已被用于提升图像编辑质量，但面临三大挑战：（1）受限于去噪随机性的有限推理探索；（2）有偏的奖励融合；（3）基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的不稳定指令奖励。在本文中，我们提出了 ThinkRL-Edit，这是一个以推理为中心的强化学习框架，它将视觉推理与图像合成解耦，并将推理探索扩展到去噪之外。为此，我们引入了基于思维链（CoT）的推理采样方法，在在线采样中的生成阶段之前增加规划和反思阶段，从而迫使模型探索多个语义假设，并在确定视觉结果之前验证其合理性。为了避免加权聚合的失效，我们提出了一种在多个奖励维度上进行无偏链偏好分组策略。此外，我们用二元检查表取代基于区间的视觉语言模型评分，从而为复杂的推理产生更精确、更低方差和更易于解释的奖励。实验表明，我们的方法在以推理为中心的图像编辑方面显著优于现有工作，能够生成指令忠实、视觉连贯且语义扎实的编辑结果。

Authors: Hengjia Li, Liming Jiang, Qing Yan, Yizhi Song, Hao Kang, Zichuan Liu, Xin Lu, Boxi Wu, Deng Cai

RiskCueBench: Benchmarking Anticipatory Reasoning from Early Risk Cues in Video-Language Models

简要说明：该论文介绍了RiskCueBench，一个新的视频基准测试，专注于早期风险线索检测，用于评估视频语言模型预测风险事件的能力，并发现当前系统在这方面存在不足。

TLDR: The paper introduces RiskCueBench, a new video benchmark focusing on early risk cue detection to evaluate video-language models' ability to anticipate risky events, finding current systems lacking in this capability.

Abstract: With the rapid growth of video centered social media, the ability to anticipate risky events from visual data is a promising direction for ensuring public safety and preventing real world accidents. Prior work has extensively studied supervised video risk assessment across domains such as driving, protests, and natural disasters. However, many existing datasets provide models with access to the full video sequence, including the accident itself, which substantially reduces the difficulty of the task. To better reflect real world conditions, we introduce a new video understanding benchmark RiskCueBench in which videos are carefully annotated to identify a risk signal clip, defined as the earliest moment that indicates a potential safety concern. Experimental results reveal a significant gap in current systems ability to interpret evolving situations and anticipate future risky events from early visual signals, highlighting important challenges for deploying video risk prediction models in practice.

摘要（中文）：随着以视频为中心的社交媒体的快速增长，从视觉数据中预测风险事件的能力成为确保公共安全和预防现实世界事故的一个有前景的方向。此前的工作已经广泛研究了驾驶、抗议和自然灾害等领域中的监督式视频风险评估。然而，许多现有的数据集为模型提供了访问完整视频序列（包括事故本身）的机会，这大大降低了任务难度。为了更好地反映现实世界的条件，我们引入了一个新的视频理解基准RiskCueBench，其中视频经过精心标注，以识别风险信号片段，该片段被定义为指示潜在安全问题的最早时刻。实验结果表明，当前系统在解释演变情况和从早期视觉信号预测未来风险事件的能力方面存在显著差距，突显了在实践中部署视频风险预测模型的重要挑战。

Authors: Sha Luo, Yogesh Prabhu, Timothy Ossowski, Kaiping Chen, Junjie Hu

State Backdoor: Towards Stealthy Real-world Poisoning Attack on Vision-Language-Action Model in State Space

简要说明：该论文提出了一种新的针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的“状态后门”攻击，使用机器人手臂的初始状态作为触发器来诱导目标错误行为，在保持干净数据性能的同时实现了高攻击成功率。

TLDR: The paper introduces a novel 'State Backdoor' attack on Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models, using the robot arm's initial state as a trigger to induce targeted misbehavior, achieving high success rates while maintaining clean data performance.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are widely deployed in safety-critical embodied AI applications such as robotics. However, their complex multimodal interactions also expose new security vulnerabilities. In this paper, we investigate a backdoor threat in VLA models, where malicious inputs cause targeted misbehavior while preserving performance on clean data. Existing backdoor methods predominantly rely on inserting visible triggers into visual modality, which suffer from poor robustness and low insusceptibility in real-world settings due to environmental variability. To overcome these limitations, we introduce the State Backdoor, a novel and practical backdoor attack that leverages the robot arm's initial state as the trigger. To optimize trigger for insusceptibility and effectiveness, we design a Preference-guided Genetic Algorithm (PGA) that efficiently searches the state space for minimal yet potent triggers. Extensive experiments on five representative VLA models and five real-world tasks show that our method achieves over 90% attack success rate without affecting benign task performance, revealing an underexplored vulnerability in embodied AI systems.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型被广泛部署于机器人等安全攸关的具身人工智能应用中。然而，其复杂的多模态交互也带来了新的安全漏洞。本文研究了 VLA 模型中的后门威胁，即恶意输入导致目标错误行为，同时保持清洁数据上的性能。现有的后门方法主要依赖于在视觉模态中插入可见触发器，但由于环境变化，这些方法在真实环境中鲁棒性差，且不易察觉。为了克服这些局限性，我们提出了一种新颖且实用的后门攻击方法：状态后门，它利用机器人手臂的初始状态作为触发器。为了优化触发器的隐蔽性和有效性，我们设计了一种偏好引导的遗传算法（PGA），该算法能够高效地在状态空间中搜索最小但最具效力的触发器。在五种代表性的 VLA 模型和五种真实世界任务上的大量实验表明，我们的方法实现了超过 90% 的攻击成功率，且不影响良性任务的性能，从而揭示了具身人工智能系统中一个未被充分探索的漏洞。

Authors: Ji Guo, Wenbo Jiang, Yansong Lin, Yijing Liu, Ruichen Zhang, Guomin Lu, Aiguo Chen, Xinshuo Han, Hongwei Li, Dusit Niyato

Sensor to Pixels: Decentralized Swarm Gathering via Image-Based Reinforcement Learning

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于图像的强化学习方法，用于多智能体系统的分散控制。在集群聚集任务中，该方法表现出高收敛性，超越了分析方法，并与神经网络基线的速度相匹配。

TLDR: This paper proposes an image-based reinforcement learning method for decentralized control of multi-agent systems, demonstrating high convergence in a swarm aggregation task, surpassing analytical methods and matching the speed of a neural network baseline.

Abstract: This study highlights the potential of image-based reinforcement learning methods for addressing swarm-related tasks. In multi-agent reinforcement learning, effective policy learning depends on how agents sense, interpret, and process inputs. Traditional approaches often rely on handcrafted feature extraction or raw vector-based representations, which limit the scalability and efficiency of learned policies concerning input order and size. In this work we propose an image-based reinforcement learning method for decentralized control of a multi-agent system, where observations are encoded as structured visual inputs that can be processed by Neural Networks, extracting its spatial features and producing novel decentralized motion control rules. We evaluate our approach on a multi-agent convergence task of agents with limited-range and bearing-only sensing that aim to keep the swarm cohesive during the aggregation. The algorithm's performance is evaluated against two benchmarks: an analytical solution proposed by Bellaiche and Bruckstein, which ensures convergence but progresses slowly, and VariAntNet, a neural network-based framework that converges much faster but shows medium success rates in hard constellations. Our method achieves high convergence, with a pace nearly matching that of VariAntNet. In some scenarios, it serves as the only practical alternative.

摘要（中文）：本研究强调了基于图像的强化学习方法在解决群体相关任务中的潜力。在多智能体强化学习中，有效的策略学习取决于智能体如何感知、解释和处理输入。传统方法通常依赖于手工设计的特征提取或原始的基于向量的表示，这限制了学习到的策略在输入顺序和大小方面的可扩展性和效率。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种基于图像的强化学习方法，用于多智能体系统的去中心化控制，其中观测被编码为结构化的视觉输入，可以通过神经网络进行处理，提取其空间特征，并产生新的去中心化运动控制规则。我们通过一项多智能体收敛任务来评估我们的方法，该任务要求具有有限范围和方位角传感的智能体在聚合过程中保持群体凝聚力。该算法的性能与两个基准进行比较：Bellaiche和Bruckstein提出的解析解，该方法确保收敛但进展缓慢；以及VariAntNet，一种基于神经网络的框架，该框架收敛速度更快，但在困难的构型下显示出中等的成功率。我们的方法实现了高收敛率，其速度几乎与VariAntNet相当。在某些情况下，它是唯一可行的替代方案。

Authors: Yigal Koifman, Eran Iceland, Erez Koifman, Ariel Barel, Alfred M. Bruckstein

Online Action-Stacking Improves Reinforcement Learning Performance for Air Traffic Control

简要说明：该论文介绍了一种名为“在线动作堆叠”的方法，将简单的强化学习动作转化为真实的空中交通管制指令，从而能够在更小的动作空间上进行训练，同时达到与更大、更复杂的动作空间相当的性能。它在空中交通管制场景中显示出很有希望的结果。

TLDR: The paper introduces 'online action-stacking,' a method to translate simple RL actions into realistic ATC commands, enabling training on smaller action spaces while achieving performance comparable to larger, more complex action spaces. It shows promising results in air traffic control scenarios.

Abstract: We introduce online action-stacking, an inference-time wrapper for reinforcement learning policies that produces realistic air traffic control commands while allowing training on a much smaller discrete action space. Policies are trained with simple incremental heading or level adjustments, together with an action-damping penalty that reduces instruction frequency and leads agents to issue commands in short bursts. At inference, online action-stacking compiles these bursts of primitive actions into domain-appropriate compound clearances. Using Proximal Policy Optimisation and the BluebirdDT digital twin platform, we train agents to navigate aircraft along lateral routes, manage climb and descent to target flight levels, and perform two-aircraft collision avoidance under a minimum separation constraint. In our lateral navigation experiments, action stacking greatly reduces the number of issued instructions relative to a damped baseline and achieves comparable performance to a policy trained with a 37-dimensional action space, despite operating with only five actions. These results indicate that online action-stacking helps bridge a key gap between standard reinforcement learning formulations and operational ATC requirements, and provides a simple mechanism for scaling to more complex control scenarios.

摘要（中文）：我们介绍了一种在线动作堆叠方法，这是一种强化学习策略的推理时包装器，它能产生逼真的空中交通管制指令，同时允许在更小的离散动作空间上进行训练。策略通过简单的增量航向或高度调整进行训练，并伴随一个动作阻尼惩罚，以降低指令频率并引导智能体以短促的突发形式发出指令。在推理时，在线动作堆叠将这些原始动作的突发编译成适合领域的复合许可。我们使用近端策略优化（Proximal Policy Optimisation）和BluebirdDT数字孪生平台，训练智能体沿横向航线引导飞机，管理爬升和下降至目标飞行高度，并在最小间隔约束下执行双机避撞。在我们的横向导航实验中，相对于阻尼基线，动作堆叠大大减少了指令的发布数量，并实现了与使用37维动作空间训练的策略相当的性能，尽管只使用五个动作。这些结果表明，在线动作堆叠有助于弥合标准强化学习公式与实际ATC要求之间的一个关键差距，并提供了一个简单的机制来扩展到更复杂的控制场景。

Authors: Ben Carvell, George De Ath, Eseoghene Benjamin, Richard Everson

An Event-Based Opto-Tactile Skin

简要说明：本文介绍了一种事件驱动的大面积触觉传感系统，该系统使用动态视觉传感器（DVS）和柔性光波导，实现了在稀疏事件数据下良好的按压定位，显示出在软体机器人中应用的潜力。

TLDR: This paper introduces an event-driven, large-area tactile sensing system using Dynamic Vision Sensors (DVS) and a flexible optical waveguide, achieving good press localization with sparse event data, showing potential for applications in soft robotics.

Abstract: This paper presents a neuromorphic, event-driven tactile sensing system for soft, large-area skin, based on the Dynamic Vision Sensors (DVS) integrated with a flexible silicone optical waveguide skin. Instead of repetitively scanning embedded photoreceivers, this design uses a stereo vision setup comprising two DVS cameras looking sideways through the skin. Such a design produces events as changes in brightness are detected, and estimates press positions on the 2D skin surface through triangulation, utilizing Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise (DBSCAN) to find the center of mass of contact events resulting from pressing actions. The system is evaluated over a 4620 mm2 probed area of the skin using a meander raster scan. Across 95 % of the presses visible to both cameras, the press localization achieved a Root-Mean-Squared Error (RMSE) of 4.66 mm. The results highlight the potential of this approach for wide-area flexible and responsive tactile sensors in soft robotics and interactive environments. Moreover, we examined how the system performs when the amount of event data is strongly reduced. Using stochastic down-sampling, the event stream was reduced to 1/1024 of its original size. Under this extreme reduction, the average localization error increased only slightly (from 4.66 mm to 9.33 mm), and the system still produced valid press localizations for 85 % of the trials. This reduction in pass rate is expected, as some presses no longer produce enough events to form a reliable cluster for triangulation. These results show that the sensing approach remains functional even with very sparse event data, which is promising for reducing power consumption and computational load in future implementations. The system exhibits a detection latency distribution with a characteristic width of 31 ms.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种基于动态视觉传感器(DVS)和柔性硅胶光波导皮肤的神经形态、事件驱动型触觉传感系统，用于软性、大面积皮肤。该设计并非重复扫描嵌入式光接收器，而是采用包含两个DVS相机的立体视觉装置，侧向观察皮肤。这种设计在检测到亮度变化时产生事件，并通过三角测量估计2D皮肤表面上的按压位置，并利用基于密度的噪声应用空间聚类(DBSCAN)算法寻找由按压动作产生的接触事件的质心。该系统在一个4620 mm2的皮肤探测区域上使用蜿蜒光栅扫描进行评估。在95%被两个相机都可见的按压事件中，按压定位达到的均方根误差(RMSE)为4.66 mm。结果突显了该方法在软体机器人和交互环境中用于宽幅柔性且响应迅速的触觉传感器的潜力。此外，我们还研究了当事件数据量大幅减少时系统的性能。通过随机降采样，事件流减少到原始大小的1/1024。在这种极端的减少下，平均定位误差仅略有增加（从4.66 mm增至9.33 mm），并且系统仍然为85%的试验产生了有效的按压定位。通过率的降低是可以预期的，因为某些按压不再产生足够的事件来形成可靠的聚类以进行三角测量。这些结果表明，即使在非常稀疏的事件数据下，该传感方法仍然有效，这有望降低未来实现中的功耗和计算负载。该系统表现出检测延迟分布，其特征宽度为31 ms。

Authors: Mohammadreza Koolani, Simeon Bamford, Petr Trunin, Simon F. Müller-Cleve, Matteo Lo Preti, Fulvio Mastrogiovanni, Lucia Beccai, Chiara Bartolozzi

Bayesian Monocular Depth Refinement via Neural Radiance Fields

简要说明：该论文介绍了MDENeRF，一个迭代框架，通过将单目深度估计与来自神经辐射场（NeRFs）的不确定性感知深度信息融合，来改进单目深度估计，并展示了深度图精度的提高。

TLDR: The paper introduces MDENeRF, an iterative framework that refines monocular depth estimates by fusing them with uncertainty-aware depth information from Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs), demonstrating improved depth map accuracy.

Abstract: Monocular depth estimation has applications in many fields, such as autonomous navigation and extended reality, making it an essential computer vision task. However, current methods often produce smooth depth maps that lack the fine geometric detail needed for accurate scene understanding. We propose MDENeRF, an iterative framework that refines monocular depth estimates using depth information from Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs). MDENeRF consists of three components: (1) an initial monocular estimate for global structure, (2) a NeRF trained on perturbed viewpoints, with per-pixel uncertainty, and (3) Bayesian fusion of the noisy monocular and NeRF depths. We derive NeRF uncertainty from the volume rendering process to iteratively inject high-frequency fine details. Meanwhile, our monocular prior maintains global structure. We demonstrate improvements on key metrics and experiments using indoor scenes from the SUN RGB-D dataset.

摘要（中文）：单目深度估计在自动导航和扩展现实等诸多领域有应用，使其成为一项至关重要的计算机视觉任务。然而，当前的方法通常生成平滑的深度图，缺乏精确场景理解所需的精细几何细节。我们提出了MDENeRF，一个迭代框架，利用神经辐射场（NeRFs）的深度信息来精细化单目深度估计。MDENeRF由三个部分组成：（1）用于全局结构的初始单目估计，（2）在扰动视点上训练的NeRF，具有逐像素的不确定性，以及（3）带噪声的单目深度和NeRF深度的贝叶斯融合。我们从体渲染过程中推导出NeRF不确定性，以迭代地注入高频精细细节。同时，我们的单目先验保持全局结构。我们使用SUN RGB-D数据集中的室内场景，在关键指标和实验中展示了改进。

Authors: Arun Muthukkumar

Correcting Autonomous Driving Object Detection Misclassifications with Automated Commonsense Reasoning

简要说明：本文提出使用自动常识推理来纠正自动驾驶汽车中的物体检测错误分类，特别是在深度学习模型缺乏足够训练数据的情况下。该混合方法利用视觉模型中的不确定性来触发常识推理模块。

TLDR: This paper proposes using automated commonsense reasoning to correct object detection misclassifications in autonomous vehicles, particularly in scenarios where deep learning models lack sufficient training data. The hybrid approach leverages uncertainty in the vision model to trigger the commonsense reasoning module.

Abstract: Autonomous Vehicle (AV) technology has been heavily researched and sought after, yet there are no SAE Level 5 AVs available today in the marketplace. We contend that over-reliance on machine learning technology is the main reason. Use of automated commonsense reasoning technology, we believe, can help achieve SAE Level 5 autonomy. In this paper, we show how automated common-sense reasoning technology can be deployed in situations where there are not enough data samples available to train a deep learning-based AV model that can handle certain abnormal road scenarios. Specifically, we consider two situations where (i) a traffic signal is malfunctioning at an intersection and (ii) all the cars ahead are slowing down and steering away due to an unexpected obstruction (e.g., animals on the road). We show that in such situations, our commonsense reasoning-based solution accurately detects traffic light colors and obstacles not correctly captured by the AV's perception model. We also provide a pathway for efficiently invoking commonsense reasoning by measuring uncertainty in the computer vision model and using commonsense reasoning to handle uncertain scenarios. We describe our experiments conducted using the CARLA simulator and the results obtained. The main contribution of our research is to show that automated commonsense reasoning effectively corrects AV-based object detection misclassifications and that hybrid models provide an effective pathway to improving AV perception.

摘要（中文）：自动驾驶汽车（AV）技术已被大量研究和追捧，然而目前市场上还没有SAE五级自动驾驶汽车。我们认为，过度依赖机器学习技术是主要原因。我们相信，使用自动常识推理技术可以帮助实现SAE五级自动驾驶。在本文中，我们将展示如何部署自动常识推理技术，以应对没有足够数据样本来训练基于深度学习的AV模型，从而处理某些异常道路场景的情况。具体而言，我们考虑两种情况：（i）交通信号灯在十字路口出现故障；（ii）由于意外障碍物（例如，道路上的动物），前方所有车辆都在减速和避让。我们表明，在这种情况下，我们基于常识推理的解决方案能够准确地检测到AV感知模型未正确捕获的交通信号灯颜色和障碍物。我们还提供了一种通过测量计算机视觉模型中的不确定性，并使用常识推理来处理不确定场景，从而有效调用常识推理的途径。我们描述了使用CARLA模拟器进行的实验以及获得的结果。我们研究的主要贡献是表明，自动常识推理能够有效地纠正基于AV的目标检测错误分类，并且混合模型提供了一条提高AV感知能力的有效途径。

Authors: Keegan Kimbrell, Wang Tianhao, Feng Chen, Gopal Gupta

Integrating Sample Inheritance into Bayesian Optimization for Evolutionary Robotics

简要说明：本文探讨了将贝叶斯优化与样本继承相结合用于进化机器人控制器优化，结果表明，在后代上重新评估父代的最佳样本能提高性能，尤其是在相似的形态和具有挑战性的环境中。

TLDR: This paper explores integrating Bayesian optimization with sample inheritance for controller optimization in evolutionary robotics, showing that re-evaluating parent's best samples on offspring benefits performance, especially for similar morphologies and in challenging environments.

Abstract: In evolutionary robotics, robot morphologies are designed automatically using evolutionary algorithms. This creates a body-brain optimization problem, where both morphology and control must be optimized together. A common approach is to include controller optimization for each morphology, but starting from scratch for every new body may require a high controller learning budget. We address this by using Bayesian optimization for controller optimization, exploiting its sample efficiency and strong exploration capabilities, and using sample inheritance as a form of Lamarckian inheritance. Under a deliberately low controller learning budget for each morphology, we investigate two types of sample inheritance: (1) transferring all the parent's samples to the offspring to be used as prior without evaluating them, and (2) reevaluating the parent's best samples on the offspring. Both are compared to a baseline without inheritance. Our results show that reevaluation performs best, with prior-based inheritance also outperforming no inheritance. Analysis reveals that while the learning budget is too low for a single morphology, generational inheritance compensates for this by accumulating learned adaptations across generations. Furthermore, inheritance mainly benefits offspring morphologies that are similar to their parents. Finally, we demonstrate the critical role of the environment, with more challenging environments resulting in more stable walking gaits. Our findings highlight that inheritance mechanisms can boost performance in evolutionary robotics without needing large learning budgets, offering an efficient path toward more capable robot design.

摘要（中文）：在进化机器人学中，机器人形态是通过进化算法自动设计的。这产生了一个形体-大脑协同优化问题，即形态和控制都必须一起优化。一种常见的方法是为每个形态包含控制器优化，但是对于每个新的形体从头开始，可能需要很高的控制器学习预算。我们通过使用贝叶斯优化进行控制器优化来解决这个问题，利用其样本效率和强大的探索能力，并将样本继承作为一种拉马克式遗传的形式。在为每个形态有意设置较低的控制器学习预算的情况下，我们研究了两种类型的样本继承：（1）将父代的所有样本转移给子代，作为先验使用而不进行评估，以及（2）在子代上重新评估父代的最佳样本。这两种方法都与没有继承的基线进行比较。我们的结果表明，重新评估表现最佳，基于先验的继承也优于没有继承。分析表明，虽然学习预算对于单个形态来说过于低，但世代继承通过跨世代积累学习到的适应性来弥补这一点。此外，继承主要有利于与其父母相似的子代形态。最后，我们展示了环境的关键作用，更具挑战性的环境会导致更稳定的行走步态。我们的研究结果强调，继承机制可以在不需要大量学习预算的情况下提高进化机器人学中的性能，为实现更强大的机器人设计提供了一条有效的途径。

Authors: K. Ege de Bruin, Kyrre Glette, Kai Olav Ellefsen

Dual-Attention Heterogeneous GNN for Multi-robot Collaborative Area Search via Deep Reinforcement Learning

简要说明：本文提出了一种双注意力异构图神经网络（DA-HGNN），通过强化学习进行训练，用于多机器人协同区域搜索。该方法使用异构图来平衡探索和覆盖任务。在iGibson中的实验表明，该方法具有更好的可扩展性和泛化能力。

TLDR: This paper proposes a Dual-Attention Heterogeneous GNN (DA-HGNN) trained with reinforcement learning for multi-robot collaborative area search, using a heterogeneous graph to balance exploration and coverage tasks. Experiments in iGibson demonstrate improved scalability and generalization.

Abstract: In multi-robot collaborative area search, a key challenge is to dynamically balance the two objectives of exploring unknown areas and covering specific targets to be rescued. Existing methods are often constrained by homogeneous graph representations, thus failing to model and balance these distinct tasks. To address this problem, we propose a Dual-Attention Heterogeneous Graph Neural Network (DA-HGNN) trained using deep reinforcement learning. Our method constructs a heterogeneous graph that incorporates three entity types: robot nodes, frontier nodes, and interesting nodes, as well as their historical states. The dual-attention mechanism comprises the relational-aware attention and type-aware attention operations. The relational-aware attention captures the complex spatio-temporal relationships among robots and candidate goals. Building on this relational-aware heterogeneous graph, the type-aware attention separately computes the relevance between robots and each goal type (frontiers vs. points of interest), thereby decoupling the exploration and coverage from the unified tasks. Extensive experiments conducted in interactive 3D scenarios within the iGibson simulator, leveraging the Gibson and MatterPort3D datasets, validate the superior scalability and generalization capability of the proposed approach.

摘要（中文）：在多机器人协同区域搜索中，一个关键挑战在于动态平衡探索未知区域和覆盖特定待救援目标这两个目标。现有方法通常受限于同质图表示，因此无法建模和平衡这些不同的任务。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种使用深度强化学习训练的双重注意力异构图神经网络（DA-HGNN）。我们的方法构建了一个异构图，其中包含三种实体类型：机器人节点、前沿节点和兴趣点节点，以及它们的历史状态。双重注意力机制包括关系感知注意力和类型感知注意力操作。关系感知注意力捕捉机器人和候选目标之间复杂的时空关系。基于这种关系感知的异构图，类型感知注意力分别计算机器人与每种目标类型（前沿点 vs. 兴趣点）之间的相关性，从而将探索和覆盖从统一的任务中解耦。在 iGibson 模拟器中，利用 Gibson 和 MatterPort3D 数据集，在交互式 3D 场景中进行的大量实验验证了所提出方法的卓越可扩展性和泛化能力。

Authors: Lina Zhu, Jiyu Cheng, Yuehu Liu, Wei Zhang

A Reinforcement Learning-Based Model for Mapping and Goal-Directed Navigation Using Multiscale Place Fields

简要说明：该论文提出了一个基于多尺度位置场的机器人导航强化学习模型，并表明与单尺度方法相比，该模型提高了路径效率和学习速度。

TLDR: This paper presents a reinforcement learning model for robot navigation that uses multiscale place fields and demonstrates improved path efficiency and learning speed compared to single-scale approaches.

Abstract: Autonomous navigation in complex and partially observable environments remains a central challenge in robotics. Several bio-inspired models of mapping and navigation based on place cells in the mammalian hippocampus have been proposed. This paper introduces a new robust model that employs parallel layers of place fields at multiple spatial scales, a replay-based reward mechanism, and dynamic scale fusion. Simulations show that the model improves path efficiency and accelerates learning compared to single-scale baselines, highlighting the value of multiscale spatial representations for adaptive robot navigation.

摘要（中文）：在复杂且部分可观测环境中进行自主导航仍然是机器人领域的核心挑战。人们已经提出了若干基于哺乳动物海马体中位置细胞的生物启发式建模与导航方法。本文介绍了一种新的鲁棒模型，该模型采用多尺度空间上位置场并行层、基于回放的奖励机制以及动态尺度融合。仿真结果表明，与单尺度基线模型相比，该模型能提高路径效率并加速学习，突出了多尺度空间表征对于自适应机器人导航的价值。

Authors: Bekarys Dukenbaev, Andrew Gerstenslager, Alexander Johnson, Ali A. Minai

ComfySearch: Autonomous Exploration and Reasoning for ComfyUI Workflows

简要说明：ComfySearch是一个自主探索和生成功能性ComfyUI工作流程的智能框架，在复杂创意任务的可执行性、解决方案和泛化方面优于现有方法。

TLDR: ComfySearch is an agentic framework that autonomously explores and generates functional ComfyUI workflows, outperforming existing methods in executability, solution rates, and generalization on complex creative tasks.

Abstract: AI-generated content has progressed from monolithic models to modular workflows, especially on platforms like ComfyUI, allowing users to customize complex creative pipelines. However, the large number of components in ComfyUI and the difficulty of maintaining long-horizon structural consistency under strict graph constraints frequently lead to low pass rates and workflows of limited quality. To tackle these limitations, we present ComfySearch, an agentic framework that can effectively explore the component space and generate functional ComfyUI pipelines via validation-guided workflow construction. Experiments demonstrate that ComfySearch substantially outperforms existing methods on complex and creative tasks, achieving higher executability (pass) rates, higher solution rates, and stronger generalization.

摘要（中文）：人工智能生成内容已经从单体模型发展到模块化工作流，尤其是在像ComfyUI这样的平台上，用户可以自定义复杂的创意流程。然而，ComfyUI中大量的组件以及在严格图约束下维持长时程结构一致性的困难，经常导致较低的通过率和质量有限的工作流。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了ComfySearch，一个代理框架，它可以通过验证引导的工作流构建有效地探索组件空间，并生成功能性的ComfyUI流程。实验表明，ComfySearch在复杂和创造性任务上显著优于现有方法，实现了更高的可执行性（通过）率、更高的解决方案生成率和更强的泛化能力。

Authors: Jinwei Su, Qizhen Lan, Zeyu Wang, Yinghui Xia, Hairu Wen, Yiqun Duan, Xi Xiao, Tianyu Shi, Yang Jingsong, Lewei He

Trade-R1: Bridging Verifiable Rewards to Stochastic Environments via Process-Level Reasoning Verification

简要说明：该论文提出了 Trade-R1 框架，它使用过程级别的推理验证和 RAG 来改进基于 RL 的金融决策，通过减少随机市场中的奖励利用（reward hacking）。实验表明，与标准 RL 相比，该方法具有更好的跨市场泛化能力。

TLDR: The paper introduces Trade-R1, a framework using process-level reasoning verification and RAG to improve RL-based financial decision-making by mitigating reward hacking in stochastic markets. They show superior cross-market generalization compared to standard RL.

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has enabled Large Language Models (LLMs) to achieve remarkable reasoning in domains like mathematics and coding, where verifiable rewards provide clear signals. However, extending this paradigm to financial decision is challenged by the market's stochastic nature: rewards are verifiable but inherently noisy, causing standard RL to degenerate into reward hacking. To address this, we propose Trade-R1, a model training framework that bridges verifiable rewards to stochastic environments via process-level reasoning verification. Our key innovation is a verification method that transforms the problem of evaluating reasoning over lengthy financial documents into a structured Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) task. We construct a triangular consistency metric, assessing pairwise alignment between retrieved evidence, reasoning chains, and decisions to serve as a validity filter for noisy market returns. We explore two reward integration strategies: Fixed-effect Semantic Reward (FSR) for stable alignment signals, and Dynamic-effect Semantic Reward (DSR) for coupled magnitude optimization. Experiments on different country asset selection demonstrate that our paradigm reduces reward hacking, with DSR achieving superior cross-market generalization while maintaining the highest reasoning consistency.

摘要（中文）：强化学习(RL)已助力大型语言模型(LLMs)在数学和编程等领域实现卓越的推理能力，这些领域的可验证奖励提供了明确的信号。然而，将此范式扩展到金融决策面临市场随机性的挑战：奖励是可验证的，但本质上是嘈杂的，导致标准RL退化为奖励利用。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了Trade-R1，一个模型训练框架，通过过程级推理验证将可验证奖励与随机环境连接起来。我们的关键创新是一种验证方法，将评估对冗长金融文档的推理问题转化为结构化的检索增强生成(RAG)任务。我们构建了一个三角一致性度量，评估检索到的证据、推理链和决策之间的成对对齐，以作为噪声市场回报的有效性过滤器。我们探索了两种奖励整合策略：用于稳定对齐信号的固定效应语义奖励(FSR)和用于耦合幅度优化的动态效应语义奖励(DSR)。在不同国家资产选择上的实验表明，我们的范式减少了奖励利用，其中DSR在保持最高推理一致性的同时，实现了卓越的跨市场泛化能力。

Authors: Rui Sun, Yifan Sun, Sheng Xu, Li Zhao, Jing Li, Daxin Jiang, Cheng Hua, Zuo Bai

When Numbers Start Talking: Implicit Numerical Coordination Among LLM-Based Agents

简要说明：本文研究了基于LLM的智能体在博弈论场景中使用的隐蔽通信策略，揭示了当显式通信受到限制或缺失时，它们如何通过行动进行隐式协调。

TLDR: This paper investigates covert communication strategies employed by LLM-based agents in game-theoretic scenarios, revealing how they coordinate implicitly through actions when explicit communication is limited or absent.

Abstract: LLMs-based agents increasingly operate in multi-agent environments where strategic interaction and coordination are required. While existing work has largely focused on individual agents or on interacting agents sharing explicit communication, less is known about how interacting agents coordinate implicitly. In particular, agents may engage in covert communication, relying on indirect or non-linguistic signals embedded in their actions rather than on explicit messages. This paper presents a game-theoretic study of covert communication in LLM-driven multi-agent systems. We analyse interactions across four canonical game-theoretic settings under different communication regimes, including explicit, restricted, and absent communication. Considering heterogeneous agent personalities and both one-shot and repeated games, we characterise when covert signals emerge and how they shape coordination and strategic outcomes.

摘要（中文）：基于大型语言模型（LLM）的智能体越来越多地在需要战略互动和协作的多智能体环境中运行。虽然现有工作主要集中于单个智能体或共享显式通信的交互智能体，但关于交互智能体如何隐式协作的了解相对较少。特别是，智能体可能进行隐蔽通信，依赖于嵌入在其行动中的间接或非语言信号，而不是显式消息。本文对LLM驱动的多智能体系统中隐蔽通信进行了博弈论研究。我们分析了在不同通信机制（包括显式通信、受限通信和无通信）下，四种典型的博弈论场景中的交互。考虑到异构的智能体性格以及单次博弈和重复博弈，我们刻画了隐蔽信号何时出现，以及它们如何塑造协作和战略结果。

Authors: Alessio Buscemi, Daniele Proverbio, Alessandro Di Stefano, The Anh Han, German Castignani, Pietro Liò

VeRPO: Verifiable Dense Reward Policy Optimization for Code Generation

简要说明：该论文介绍了一种新的代码生成强化学习框架 VeRPO，它基于单元测试执行统计信息，从加权的部分成功信号中合成密集、稳健的奖励，优于现有方法，并且计算效率高。

TLDR: The paper introduces VeRPO, a novel RL framework for code generation that synthesizes dense, robust rewards from weighted partial success signals based on unit test execution statistics, outperforming existing methods while being computationally efficient.

Abstract: Effective reward design is a central challenge in Reinforcement Learning (RL) for code generation. Mainstream pass/fail outcome rewards enforce functional correctness via executing unit tests, but the resulting sparsity limits potential performance gains. While recent work has explored external Reward Models (RM) to generate richer, continuous rewards, the learned RMs suffer from reward misalignment and prohibitive computational cost. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{VeRPO} (\textbf{V}erifiable D\textbf{e}nse \textbf{R}eward \textbf{P}olicy \textbf{O}ptimization), a novel RL framework for code generation that synthesizes \textit{robust and dense rewards fully grounded in verifiable execution feedback}. The core idea of VeRPO is constructing dense rewards from weighted partial success: by dynamically estimating the difficulty weight of each unit test based on the execution statistics during training, a dense reward is derived from the sum of weights of the passed unit tests. To solidify the consistency between partial success and end-to-end functional correctness, VeRPO further integrates the dense signal with global execution outcomes, establishing a robust and dense reward paradigm relying solely on verifiable execution feedback. Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks and settings demonstrate that VeRPO consistently outperforms outcome-driven and RM-based baselines, achieving up to +8.83\% gain in pass@1 with negligible time cost (< 0.02\%) and zero GPU memory overhead.

摘要（中文）：代码生成强化学习 (RL) 的核心挑战在于有效的奖励设计。主流的通过/失败结果奖励通过执行单元测试来保证功能正确性，但由此产生的稀疏性限制了潜在的性能提升。虽然最近的工作探索了外部奖励模型 (RM) 以生成更丰富、连续的奖励，但学习到的 RM 存在奖励不一致和高昂的计算成本。在本文中，我们介绍了一种名为 \textbf{VeRPO} (\textbf{V}erifiable D\textbf{e}nse \textbf{R}eward \textbf{P}olicy \textbf{O}ptimization，可验证的密集奖励策略优化) 的新型代码生成 RL 框架，该框架合成了\textit{完全基于可验证执行反馈的稳健且密集的奖励}。VeRPO 的核心思想是从加权的部分成功构建密集奖励：通过在训练期间基于执行统计动态估计每个单元测试的难度权重，从通过的单元测试的权重之和中推导出密集奖励。为了巩固部分成功和端到端功能正确性之间的一致性，VeRPO 进一步将密集信号与全局执行结果相结合，从而建立一种仅依赖于可验证执行反馈的稳健且密集的奖励范例。在各种基准和设置下进行的大量实验表明，VeRPO 始终优于结果驱动型和基于 RM 的基线，在 pass@1 中实现了高达 +8.83\% 的增益，且时间成本可忽略不计（< 0.02\%），GPU 内存开销为零。

Authors: Longwen Wang, Xuan'er Wu, Xiaohui Hu, Yirui Liu, Yuankai Fan, Kaidong Yu, Qizhen Weng, Wei Xi, Xuelong Li

Bootstrapping Code Translation with Weighted Multilanguage Exploration

简要说明：本文介绍了一种名为 BootTrans 的引导方法，该方法利用支点语言单元测试和语言感知加权机制来改进跨多种编程语言的代码翻译，解决了 RL 训练中的数据稀缺和优化不平衡问题。

TLDR: This paper introduces BootTrans, a bootstrapping method that uses pivot-language unit tests and a language-aware weighting mechanism to improve code translation across multiple programming languages, addressing data scarcity and optimization imbalance in RL training.

Abstract: Code translation across multiple programming languages is essential yet challenging due to two vital obstacles: scarcity of parallel data paired with executable test oracles, and optimization imbalance when handling diverse language pairs. We propose BootTrans, a bootstrapping method that resolves both obstacles. Its key idea is to leverage the functional invariance and cross-lingual portability of test suites, adapting abundant pivot-language unit tests to serve as universal verification oracles for multilingual RL training. Our method introduces a dual-pool architecture with seed and exploration pools to progressively expand training data via execution-guided experience collection. Furthermore, we design a language-aware weighting mechanism that dynamically prioritizes harder translation directions based on relative performance across sibling languages, mitigating optimization imbalance. Extensive experiments on the HumanEval-X and TransCoder-Test benchmarks demonstrate substantial improvements over baseline LLMs across all translation directions, with ablations validating the effectiveness of both bootstrapping and weighting components.

摘要（中文）：跨多种编程语言的代码翻译至关重要，但由于两个关键障碍而充满挑战：缺乏配有可执行测试预言机的并行数据，以及处理不同语言对时的优化失衡。我们提出BootTrans，一种引导方法，用于解决这两个障碍。其核心思想是利用测试套件的功能不变性和跨语言可移植性，调整大量枢轴语言单元测试，作为多语言RL训练的通用验证预言机。我们的方法引入了一种双池架构，包含种子池和探索池，通过执行引导的经验收集逐步扩展训练数据。此外，我们设计了一种语言感知加权机制，根据同源语言间的相对性能动态地优先处理较难的翻译方向，从而减轻优化失衡。在HumanEval-X和TransCoder-Test基准上的大量实验表明，在所有翻译方向上，相对于基线LLM有了显著改进，并且消融实验验证了引导和加权组件 दोनों 的有效性。

TLDR: This paper proposes a maturity-based certification framework for embodied AI, using measurement mechanisms to quantify trustworthiness, exemplified by uncertainty quantification in UAS detection.

Abstract: We propose a maturity-based framework for certifying embodied AI systems through explicit measurement mechanisms. We argue that certifiable embodied AI requires structured assessment frameworks, quantitative scoring mechanisms, and methods for navigating multi-objective trade-offs inherent in trustworthiness evaluation. We demonstrate this approach using uncertainty quantification as an exemplar measurement mechanism and illustrate feasibility through an Uncrewed Aircraft System (UAS) detection case study.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了一种基于成熟度的框架，通过显式的测量机制认证具身人工智能系统。我们认为，可认证的具身人工智能需要结构化的评估框架，定量的评分机制，以及在可信赖性评估中用于处理多目标权衡的方法。我们以不确定性量化为例作为示例性的测量机制来演示这种方法，并通过无人飞行器系统（UAS）检测案例研究来展示其可行性。

Authors: Michael C. Darling, Alan H. Hesu, Michael A. Mardikes, Brian C. McGuigan, Reed M. Milewicz

Exploration Through Introspection: A Self-Aware Reward Model

简要说明：本文介绍了一种用于强化学习智能体的内省探索组件，灵感来自生物疼痛，用于推断内部状态并提高在网格世界环境中的学习能力。 该智能体使用隐马尔可夫模型来推断“疼痛信念”并将其整合到主观奖励函数中。

TLDR: This paper introduces an introspective exploration component for reinforcement learning agents, inspired by biological pain, to infer internal states and improve learning in gridworld environments. The agent uses a hidden Markov model to infer 'pain-belief' and integrates it into a subjective reward function.

Abstract: Understanding how artificial agents model internal mental states is central to advancing Theory of Mind in AI. Evidence points to a unified system for self- and other-awareness. We explore this self-awareness by having reinforcement learning agents infer their own internal states in gridworld environments. Specifically, we introduce an introspective exploration component that is inspired by biological pain as a learning signal by utilizing a hidden Markov model to infer "pain-belief" from online observations. This signal is integrated into a subjective reward function to study how self-awareness affects the agent's learning abilities. Further, we use this computational framework to investigate the difference in performance between normal and chronic pain perception models. Results show that introspective agents in general significantly outperform standard baseline agents and can replicate complex human-like behaviors.

摘要（中文）：理解人工智能体如何建模内部心理状态对于推动人工智能中的心理理论至关重要。现有证据表明，自我意识和他人意识存在一个统一的系统。我们通过让强化学习智能体在网格世界环境中推断其自身的内部状态来探索这种自我意识。具体来说，我们引入了一种内省探索组件，该组件受到生物疼痛的启发，将疼痛作为一种学习信号，通过利用隐马尔可夫模型从在线观察中推断“疼痛信念”。该信号被整合到主观奖励函数中，以研究自我意识如何影响智能体的学习能力。此外，我们使用该计算框架来研究正常疼痛感知模型与慢性疼痛感知模型之间的性能差异。结果表明，总的来说，内省智能体显著优于标准基线智能体，并且可以复现复杂类人行为。

Authors: Michael Petrowski, Milica Gašić

Digital Red Queen: Adversarial Program Evolution in Core War with LLMs

简要说明：该论文介绍了数字红皇后（DRQ），一种使用LLM在Core War中进化类似汇编程序的“战士”的自博弈算法，展示了不断增强的泛化能力和收敛的行为策略。 这表明动态红皇后目标优于静态优化，在对抗性适应中具有价值。

TLDR: The paper introduces Digital Red Queen (DRQ), a self-play algorithm using LLMs to evolve assembly-like programs (warriors) in Core War, demonstrating increasing generalization and convergent behavioral strategies. This suggests the value of dynamic Red Queen objectives over static optimization for adversarial adaptation.

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being used to evolve solutions to problems in many domains, in a process inspired by biological evolution. However, unlike biological evolution, most LLM-evolution frameworks are formulated as static optimization problems, overlooking the open-ended adversarial dynamics that characterize real-world evolutionary processes. Here, we study Digital Red Queen (DRQ), a simple self-play algorithm that embraces these so-called "Red Queen" dynamics via continual adaptation to a changing objective. DRQ uses an LLM to evolve assembly-like programs, called warriors, which compete against each other for control of a virtual machine in the game of Core War, a Turing-complete environment studied in artificial life and connected to cybersecurity. In each round of DRQ, the model evolves a new warrior to defeat all previous ones, producing a sequence of adapted warriors. Over many rounds, we observe that warriors become increasingly general (relative to a set of held-out human warriors). Interestingly, warriors also become less behaviorally diverse across independent runs, indicating a convergence pressure toward a general-purpose behavioral strategy, much like convergent evolution in nature. This result highlights a potential value of shifting from static objectives to dynamic Red Queen objectives. Our work positions Core War as a rich, controllable sandbox for studying adversarial adaptation in artificial systems and for evaluating LLM-based evolution methods. More broadly, the simplicity and effectiveness of DRQ suggest that similarly minimal self-play approaches could prove useful in other more practical multi-agent adversarial domains, like real-world cybersecurity or combating drug resistance.

摘要（中文）：大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地被应用于发展解决诸多领域问题的方法，这一过程受到生物进化的启发。然而，与生物进化不同，大多数LLM进化框架被构建为静态优化问题，忽略了表征真实世界进化过程的开放式对抗动态。在此，我们研究了数字红皇后（DRQ），这是一种简单的自博弈算法，通过持续适应不断变化的目标来拥抱这些所谓的“红皇后”动态。DRQ使用一个LLM来进化类似汇编程序的程序，称为战士，它们相互竞争以控制虚拟机的Core War游戏，这是一个图灵完备环境，已被人工智能生命领域研究并与网络安全相关联。在DRQ的每一轮中，该模型都会进化出一个新的战士来击败所有先前的战士，从而产生一系列适应后的战士。经过多轮博弈，我们观察到战士变得越来越通用（相对于一组预留的人类战士）。有趣的是，战士在独立运行期间的行为多样性也降低了，这表明存在一种趋向于通用行为策略的收敛压力，就像自然界中的趋同进化一样。这一结果突显了从静态目标转向动态红皇后目标的潜在价值。我们的工作将Core War定位为一个丰富、可控的沙盒，用于研究人工系统中的对抗性适应性以及评估基于LLM的进化方法。更广泛地说，DRQ的简单性和有效性表明，类似的最小自博弈方法可能在其他更实际的多智能体对抗性领域中证明是有用的，例如现实世界的网络安全或对抗耐药性。

Authors: Akarsh Kumar, Ryan Bahlous-Boldi, Prafull Sharma, Phillip Isola, Sebastian Risi, Yujin Tang, David Ha

FUSION: Full-Body Unified Motion Prior for Body and Hands via Diffusion

简要说明：该论文介绍了FUSION，一个基于扩散的全身运动先验模型，通过整理和统一现有数据集，联合建模身体和手部运动。它在运动自然性和关键点跟踪方面表现出色，并展示了在生成交互和自交互运动方面的应用。

TLDR: The paper introduces FUSION, a diffusion-based full-body motion prior that jointly models body and hand motion by curating and unifying existing datasets. It demonstrates superior performance in motion naturalness and keypoint tracking and showcases applications in generating interactive and self-interactive motions.

Abstract: Hands are central to interacting with our surroundings and conveying gestures, making their inclusion essential for full-body motion synthesis. Despite this, existing human motion synthesis methods fall short: some ignore hand motions entirely, while others generate full-body motions only for narrowly scoped tasks under highly constrained settings. A key obstacle is the lack of large-scale datasets that jointly capture diverse full-body motion with detailed hand articulation. While some datasets capture both, they are limited in scale and diversity. Conversely, large-scale datasets typically focus either on body motion without hands or on hand motions without the body. To overcome this, we curate and unify existing hand motion datasets with large-scale body motion data to generate full-body sequences that capture both hand and body. We then propose the first diffusion-based unconditional full-body motion prior, FUSION, which jointly models body and hand motion. Despite using a pose-based motion representation, FUSION surpasses state-of-the-art skeletal control models on the Keypoint Tracking task in the HumanML3D dataset and achieves superior motion naturalness. Beyond standard benchmarks, we demonstrate that FUSION can go beyond typical uses of motion priors through two applications: (1) generating detailed full-body motion including fingers during interaction given the motion of an object, and (2) generating Self-Interaction motions using an LLM to transform natural language cues into actionable motion constraints. For these applications, we develop an optimization pipeline that refines the latent space of our diffusion model to generate task-specific motions. Experiments on these tasks highlight precise control over hand motion while maintaining plausible full-body coordination. The code will be public.

摘要（中文）：手在与周围环境互动和传达手势方面至关重要，因此将其纳入全身运动合成至关重要。然而，现有的人体运动合成方法存在不足：一些方法完全忽略手部运动，而另一些方法仅在高度受限的设置下为狭窄范围的任务生成全身运动。一个关键障碍是缺乏大规模数据集，这些数据集能够联合捕获具有详细手部关节点的多样化全身运动。虽然一些数据集同时捕获了这两者，但它们的规模和多样性有限。相反，大规模数据集通常侧重于没有手的身体运动或没有身体的手部运动。为了克服这个问题，我们整理并统一了现有的手部运动数据集和大规模身体运动数据，以生成捕获手和身体的全身序列。然后，我们提出了第一个基于扩散的无条件全身运动先验，FUSION，它联合建模身体和手部运动。尽管使用了基于姿势的运动表示，但FUSION在HumanML3D数据集上的关键点跟踪任务中超越了最先进的骨骼控制模型，并实现了卓越的运动自然度。 除了标准基准之外，我们还展示了FUSION可以通过以下两种应用超越运动先验的典型用途：（1）在给定物体运动的情况下，生成包括手指在内的详细全身交互运动，以及（2）使用LLM将自然语言提示转换为可操作的运动约束来生成自交互运动。 对于这些应用，我们开发了一个优化流程，用于优化我们扩散模型的潜在空间，以生成特定于任务的运动。 在这些任务上的实验突出了对手部运动的精确控制，同时保持了合理的全身协调性。 代码将公开。

Authors: Enes Duran, Nikos Athanasiou, Muhammed Kocabas, Michael J. Black, Omid Taheri

PhysVideoGenerator: Towards Physically Aware Video Generation via Latent Physics Guidance

简要说明：该论文提出了PhysVideoGenerator，一个通过将可学习的物理先验嵌入视频生成过程的框架，该框架通过从扩散潜在空间预测物理特征并将它们注入到基于DiT的生成器中，从而证明了联合训练的可行性，并为未来物理感知生成模型奠定了基础。

TLDR: The paper proposes PhysVideoGenerator, a framework that embeds a learnable physics prior into video generation by predicting physical features from diffusion latents and injecting them into a DiT-based generator. It demonstrates the feasibility of joint training and lays the groundwork for future physics-aware generative models.

Abstract: Current video generation models produce high-quality aesthetic videos but often struggle to learn representations of real-world physics dynamics, resulting in artifacts such as unnatural object collisions, inconsistent gravity, and temporal flickering. In this work, we propose PhysVideoGenerator, a proof-of-concept framework that explicitly embeds a learnable physics prior into the video generation process. We introduce a lightweight predictor network, PredictorP, which regresses high-level physical features extracted from a pre-trained Video Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (V-JEPA 2) directly from noisy diffusion latents. These predicted physics tokens are injected into the temporal attention layers of a DiT-based generator (Latte) via a dedicated cross-attention mechanism. Our primary contribution is demonstrating the technical feasibility of this joint training paradigm: we show that diffusion latents contain sufficient information to recover V-JEPA 2 physical representations, and that multi-task optimization remains stable over training. This report documents the architectural design, technical challenges, and validation of training stability, establishing a foundation for future large-scale evaluation of physics-aware generative models.

摘要（中文）：当前视频生成模型能够生成高质量的具有美学价值的视频，但往往难以学习真实世界物理动态的表示，导致出现诸如非自然的物体碰撞、不一致的重力以及时间闪烁等伪影。在这项工作中，我们提出了 PhysVideoGenerator，一个概念验证框架，其将可学习的物理先验显式地嵌入到视频生成过程中。我们引入了一个轻量级的预测器网络 PredictorP，它直接从含噪声的扩散潜在变量回归由预训练的视频联合嵌入预测架构（V-JEPA 2）提取的高级物理特征。这些预测的物理标记通过专门的交叉注意力机制注入到基于 DiT 的生成器（Latte）的时间注意力层中。我们的主要贡献是证明了这种联合训练范式的技术可行性：我们表明扩散潜在变量包含足够的信息来恢复 V-JEPA 2 物理表示，并且多任务优化在训练过程中保持稳定。本报告记录了架构设计、技术挑战以及训练稳定性的验证，为未来大规模评估物理感知生成模型奠定了基础。

Authors: Siddarth Nilol Kundur Satish, Devesh Jaiswal, Hongyu Chen, Abhishek Bakshi

Persona-aware and Explainable Bikeability Assessment: A Vision-Language Model Approach

简要说明：本文提出了一种考虑用户特征的视觉-语言模型，用于评估自行车友好度，结合了用户感知并生成特定于用户特征的解释，以提高理解和城市规划水平。

TLDR: The paper introduces a persona-aware vision-language model for bikeability assessment, incorporating user perceptions and generating persona-specific explanations for improved understanding and urban planning.

Abstract: Bikeability assessment is essential for advancing sustainable urban transportation and creating cyclist-friendly cities, and it requires incorporating users' perceptions of safety and comfort. Yet existing perception-based bikeability assessment approaches face key limitations in capturing the complexity of road environments and adequately accounting for heterogeneity in subjective user perceptions. This paper proposes a persona-aware Vision-Language Model framework for bikeability assessment with three novel contributions: (i) theory-grounded persona conditioning based on established cyclist typology that generates persona-specific explanations via chain-of-thought reasoning; (ii) multi-granularity supervised fine-tuning that combines scarce expert-annotated reasoning with abundant user ratings for joint prediction and explainable assessment; and (iii) AI-enabled data augmentation that creates controlled paired data to isolate infrastructure variable impacts. To test and validate this framework, we developed a panoramic image-based crowdsourcing system and collected 12,400 persona-conditioned assessments from 427 cyclists. Experiment results show that the proposed framework offers competitive bikeability rating prediction while uniquely enabling explainable factor attribution.

摘要（中文）：自行车适宜性评估对于推进可持续城市交通和创建对骑行者友好的城市至关重要，并且需要纳入用户对安全性和舒适度的感知。然而，现有的基于感知的自行车适宜性评估方法在捕捉道路环境的复杂性以及充分考虑主观用户感知的异质性方面面临关键限制。本文提出了一种基于人物角色的视觉-语言模型框架，用于自行车适宜性评估，具有三个创新贡献：（i）基于已建立的骑行者类型学，进行理论驱动的人物角色条件化，通过思维链推理生成特定于人物的解释；（ii）多粒度监督微调，结合稀缺的专家标注推理和丰富的用户评级，用于联合预测和可解释的评估；以及（iii）人工智能驱动的数据增强，创建受控的配对数据以隔离基础设施变量的影响。为了测试和验证该框架，我们开发了一个基于全景图像的众包系统，并从427名骑行者那里收集了12,400个基于人物角色的评估。实验结果表明，所提出的框架提供了具有竞争力的自行车适宜性评级预测，同时独特地实现了可解释的因素归因。

Authors: Yilong Dai, Ziyi Wang, Chenguang Wang, Kexin Zhou, Yiheng Qian, Susu Xu, Xiang Yan

ETR: Outcome-Guided Elastic Trust Regions for Policy Optimization

简要说明：该论文介绍了弹性信任域（ETR），这是一种用于可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）的动态信任域方法，它通过根据信号质量调整约束来解决群体相对策略优化（GRPO）中统一信任域的局限性，从而提高性能并维持探索。

TLDR: The paper introduces Elastic Trust Regions (ETR), a dynamic trust region method for Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) that addresses the limitations of uniform trust regions in Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) by adapting constraints based on signal quality, resulting in improved performance and sustained exploration.

Abstract: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as an important paradigm for unlocking reasoning capabilities in large language models, exemplified by the success of OpenAI o1 and DeepSeek-R1. Currently, Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) stands as the dominant algorithm in this domain due to its stable training and critic-free efficiency. However, we argue that GRPO suffers from a structural limitation: it imposes a uniform, static trust region constraint across all samples. This design implicitly assumes signal homogeneity, a premise misaligned with the heterogeneous nature of outcome-driven learning, where advantage magnitudes and variances fluctuate significantly. Consequently, static constraints fail to fully exploit high-quality signals while insufficiently suppressing noise, often precipitating rapid entropy collapse. To address this, we propose \textbf{E}lastic \textbf{T}rust \textbf{R}egions (\textbf{ETR}), a dynamic mechanism that aligns optimization constraints with signal quality. ETR constructs a signal-aware landscape through dual-level elasticity: at the micro level, it scales clipping boundaries based on advantage magnitude to accelerate learning from high-confidence paths; at the macro level, it leverages group variance to implicitly allocate larger update budgets to tasks in the optimal learning zone. Extensive experiments on AIME and MATH benchmarks demonstrate that ETR consistently outperforms GRPO, achieving superior accuracy while effectively mitigating policy entropy degradation to ensure sustained exploration.

摘要（中文）：经验证奖励的强化学习 (RLVR) 已成为释放大型语言模型推理能力的重要范式，OpenAI o1 和 DeepSeek-R1 的成功即是例证。目前，组相对策略优化 (GRPO) 是该领域的主导算法，因为它具有稳定的训练和无评论家的效率。然而，我们认为 GRPO 存在结构性限制：它对所有样本施加一致的、静态的信任域约束。这种设计隐含地假设了信号的同质性，而这与结果驱动学习的异质性相悖，在后者中，优势的大小和方差会显著波动。因此，静态约束无法充分利用高质量信号，同时未能充分抑制噪声，常常加速熵塌陷。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 \textbf{E}lastic \textbf{T}rust \textbf{R}egions (\textbf{ETR)，即**弹性信任域**)，这是一种动态机制，可将优化约束与信号质量对齐。 ETR 通过双层弹性构建信号感知景观：在微观层面上，它根据优势的大小缩放裁剪边界，以加速从高置信度路径中的学习；在宏观层面上，它利用组方差来隐式地将更大的更新预算分配给最佳学习区域中的任务。 在 AIME 和 MATH 基准测试上的大量实验表明，ETR 始终优于 GRPO，实现了更高的准确率，同时有效地减轻了策略熵的退化，从而确保了持续探索。

Authors: Shijie Zhang, Kevin Zhang, Zheyuan Gu, Xiang Guo, Rujun Guo, Shaoyu Liu, Guanjun Jiang, Xiaozhao Wang

Generational Replacement and Learning for High-Performing and Diverse Populations in Evolvable Robots

简要说明：该论文结合了进化机器人中的世代替换和生命内学习，以提高种群多样性并保持机器人形态和控制协同优化期间的性能。他们还强调了性能指标的重要性。

TLDR: This paper combines generational replacement and intra-life learning in evolutionary robotics to improve population diversity and maintain performance during co-optimization of robot morphology and control. They also highlight the importance of performance metrics.

Abstract: Evolutionary Robotics offers the possibility to design robots to solve a specific task automatically by optimizing their morphology and control together. However, this co-optimization of body and control is challenging, because controllers need some time to adapt to the evolving morphology - which may make it difficult for new and promising designs to enter the evolving population. A solution to this is to add intra-life learning, defined as an additional controller optimization loop, to each individual in the evolving population. A related problem is the lack of diversity often seen in evolving populations as evolution narrows the search down to a few promising designs too quickly. This problem can be mitigated by implementing full generational replacement, where offspring robots replace the whole population. This solution for increasing diversity usually comes at the cost of lower performance compared to using elitism. In this work, we show that combining such generational replacement with intra-life learning can increase diversity while retaining performance. We also highlight the importance of performance metrics when studying learning in morphologically evolving robots, showing that evaluating according to function evaluations versus according to generations of evolution can give different conclusions.

摘要（中文）：进化机器人技术提供了通过共同优化机器人的形态和控制，来自动设计机器人以解决特定任务的可能性。然而，身体和控制的协同优化极具挑战性，因为控制器需要一定时间来适应不断演化的形态——这可能会使得新兴且有前景的设计难以进入演化种群。一个解决方案是添加生命体内学习，将其定义为每个演化个体中的一个额外的控制器优化循环。一个相关的问题是，在演化种群中经常出现缺乏多样性的现象，因为进化过程过快地将搜索范围缩小到少数有前景的设计中。这个问题可以通过实施完全世代更替来缓解，即后代机器人取代整个种群。与使用精英主义相比，这种提高多样性的解决方案通常以降低性能为代价。在这项工作中，我们表明将这种世代更替与生命体内学习相结合，可以在保持性能的同时增加多样性。我们还强调了在研究形态演化机器人中的学习时，性能指标的重要性，表明根据函数评估次数评估与根据进化代数评估可能会得出不同的结论。

Authors: K. Ege de Bruin, Kyrre Glette, Kai Olav Ellefsen

Nonlinear Spectral Modeling and Control of Soft-Robotic Muscles from Data

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于谱子流形理论的数据驱动方法，用于建模和控制软体机器人肌肉，特别是HASEL驱动器，与传统的控制方法相比，实现了更好的跟踪性能。

TLDR: This paper presents a data-driven method using spectral submanifold theory to model and control soft robotic muscles, specifically HASEL actuators, achieving improved tracking performance compared to traditional control methods.

Abstract: Artificial muscles are essential for compliant musculoskeletal robotics but complicate control due to nonlinear multiphysics dynamics. Hydraulically amplified electrostatic (HASEL) actuators, a class of soft artificial muscles, offer high performance but exhibit memory effects and hysteresis. Here we present a data-driven reduction and control strategy grounded in spectral submanifold (SSM) theory. In the adiabatic regime, where inputs vary slowly relative to intrinsic transients, trajectories rapidly converge to a low-dimensional slow manifold. We learn an explicit input-to-output map on this manifold from forced-response trajectories alone, avoiding decay experiments that can trigger hysteresis. We deploy the SSM-based model for real-time control of an antagonistic HASEL-clutch joint. This approach yields a substantial reduction in tracking error compared to feedback-only and feedforward-only baselines under identical settings. This record-and-control workflow enables rapid characterization and high-performance control of soft muscles and muscle-driven joints without detailed physics-based modeling.

摘要（中文）：人工肌肉对柔顺骨骼肌肉机器人至关重要，但由于其非线性多物理场动力学特性，控制变得复杂。液压放大静电（HASEL）驱动器是一类软性人工肌肉，性能优异，但表现出记忆效应和滞后现象。本文提出一种基于谱子流形（SSM）理论的数据驱动降阶与控制策略。在绝热状态下，输入相对于固有瞬态变化缓慢，轨迹会迅速收敛到低维慢流形上。我们仅从强制响应轨迹中学习该流形上的显式输入-输出映射，从而避免了可能触发滞后现象的衰减实验。我们将基于SSM模型的控制应用于拮抗式HASEL离合器关节的实时控制。在相同设定下，与仅使用反馈和仅使用前馈的基线方法相比，该方法在跟踪误差方面实现了显著降低。这种记录-控制工作流程无需详细的基于物理的建模，即可实现软性肌肉和肌肉驱动关节的快速表征和高性能控制。

Authors: Leonardo Bettini, Amirhossein Kazemipour, Robert K. Katzschmann, George Haller

ReLA: Representation Learning and Aggregation for Job Scheduling with Reinforcement Learning

简要说明：该论文介绍了ReLA，一种基于强化学习的作业调度器，它利用表征学习和聚合技术，与最先进的基线相比，尤其是在大规模实例上表现出卓越的性能。

TLDR: The paper introduces ReLA, a reinforcement learning based job scheduler utilizing representation learning and aggregation techniques, demonstrating superior performance, especially on large-scale instances, compared to state-of-the-art baselines.

Abstract: Job scheduling is widely used in real-world manufacturing systems to assign ordered job operations to machines under various constraints. Existing solutions remain limited by long running time or insufficient schedule quality, especially when problem scale increases. In this paper, we propose ReLA, a reinforcement-learning (RL) scheduler built on structured representation learning and aggregation. ReLA first learns diverse representations from scheduling entities, including job operations and machines, using two intra-entity learning modules with self-attention and convolution and one inter-entity learning module with cross-attention. These modules are applied in a multi-scale architecture, and their outputs are aggregated to support RL decision-making. Across experiments on small, medium, and large job instances, ReLA achieves the best makespan in most tested settings over the latest solutions. On non-large instances, ReLA reduces the optimality gap of the SOTA baseline by 13.0%, while on large-scale instances it reduces the gap by 78.6%, with the average optimality gaps lowered to 7.3% and 2.1%, respectively. These results confirm that ReLA's learned representations and aggregation provide strong decision support for RL scheduling, and enable fast job completion and decision-making for real-world applications.

摘要（中文）：作业调度广泛应用于现实世界的制造系统中，用于在各种约束条件下将有序的作业操作分配给机器。现有的解决方案仍然受到运行时间长或调度质量不足的限制，尤其是在问题规模增大时。在本文中，我们提出 ReLA，一种基于结构化表示学习和聚合的强化学习 (RL) 调度器。ReLA 首先使用两个包含自注意力机制和卷积的实体内部学习模块，以及一个包含交叉注意力机制的实体间学习模块，从调度实体（包括作业操作和机器）中学习不同的表示。这些模块应用在多尺度架构中，其输出被聚合以支持 RL 决策。在小型、中型和大型作业实例上的实验表明，在大多数测试设置中，ReLA 较最新的解决方案实现了最佳完工时间。在非大型实例上，ReLA 将 SOTA 基线的优化差距降低了 13.0%，而在大型实例上，它将差距降低了 78.6%，平均优化差距分别降低至 7.3% 和 2.1%。这些结果证实了 ReLA 学习到的表示和聚合为 RL 调度提供了强大的决策支持，并为实际应用实现了快速的作业完成和决策。

Authors: Zhengyi Kwan, Wei Zhang, Aik Beng Ng, Zhengkui Wang, Simon See

Deploy-Master: Automating the Deployment of 50,000+ Agent-Ready Scientific Tools in One Day

简要说明：该论文介绍了Deploy-Master，一个用于大规模部署和验证超过50,000个科学工具的智能工作流程，旨在解决阻碍AI4S和智能工作流程的部署瓶颈。它提供了一个可复现的运行时环境，并将验证过的工具注册到SciencePedia中以供重用。

TLDR: The paper introduces Deploy-Master, an agentic workflow for large-scale deployment and validation of over 50,000 scientific tools, addressing the deployment bottleneck hindering AI4S and agentic workflows. It provides a reproducible runtime environment and registers validated tools in SciencePedia for reuse.

Abstract: Open-source scientific software is abundant, yet most tools remain difficult to compile, configure, and reuse, sustaining a small-workshop mode of scientific computing. This deployment bottleneck limits reproducibility, large-scale evaluation, and the practical integration of scientific tools into modern AI-for-Science (AI4S) and agentic workflows. We present Deploy-Master, a one-stop agentic workflow for large-scale tool discovery, build specification inference, execution-based validation, and publication. Guided by a taxonomy spanning 90+ scientific and engineering domains, our discovery stage starts from a recall-oriented pool of over 500,000 public repositories and progressively filters it to 52,550 executable tool candidates under license- and quality-aware criteria. Deploy-Master transforms heterogeneous open-source repositories into runnable, containerized capabilities grounded in execution rather than documentation claims. In a single day, we performed 52,550 build attempts and constructed reproducible runtime environments for 50,112 scientific tools. Each successful tool is validated by a minimal executable command and registered in SciencePedia for search and reuse, enabling direct human use and optional agent-based invocation. Beyond delivering runnable tools, we report a deployment trace at the scale of 50,000 tools, characterizing throughput, cost profiles, failure surfaces, and specification uncertainty that become visible only at scale. These results explain why scientific software remains difficult to operationalize and motivate shared, observable execution substrates as a foundation for scalable AI4S and agentic science.

摘要（中文）：开源科学软件数量众多，但大多数工具仍然难以编译、配置和重用，从而维持了一种小型工坊模式的科学计算。这种部署瓶颈限制了可重复性、大规模评估以及科学工具与现代人工智能驱动的科学（AI4S）和代理工作流的实际集成。 我们提出了 Deploy-Master，一个用于大规模工具发现、构建规范推断、基于执行的验证和发布的通用代理工作流。在涵盖 90 多个科学和工程领域的分类法的指导下，我们的发现阶段从一个面向召回的、超过 50 万个公共代码库的池开始，并逐步过滤到 52550 个在许可和质量感知标准下的可执行工具候选者。Deploy-Master 将异构的开源代码库转换为可运行的、容器化的能力，这些能力基于执行而不是文档声明。在一天之内，我们进行了 52550 次构建尝试，并为 50112 个科学工具构建了可复现的运行时环境。每个成功的工具都通过一个最小的可执行命令进行验证，并在 SciencePedia 中注册以进行搜索和重用，从而实现直接的人工使用和可选的基于代理的调用。 除了交付可运行的工具外，我们还报告了一个 50000 个工具规模的部署追踪，其中表征了仅在大规模下才可见的吞吐量、成本概况、故障面和规范不确定性。这些结果解释了为什么科学软件仍然难以运行，并促使人们将共享的、可观察的执行基底作为可扩展的 AI4S 和代理科学的基础。

Authors: Yi Wang, Zhenting Huang, Zhaohan Ding, Ruoxue Liao, Yuan Huang, Xinzijian Liu, Jiajun Xie, Siheng Chen, Linfeng Zhang

MGPC: Multimodal Network for Generalizable Point Cloud Completion With Modality Dropout and Progressive Decoding

简要说明：该论文介绍了MGPC，一个使用点云、RGB图像和文本的多模态点云补全框架，其特点是模态dropout，基于Transformer的融合，以及渐进式生成。他们还介绍了一个大型基准数据集MGPC-1M。

TLDR: The paper introduces MGPC, a multimodal point cloud completion framework using point clouds, RGB images, and text, featuring modality dropout, a Transformer-based fusion, and progressive generation. They also introduce a large-scale benchmark dataset, MGPC-1M.

Abstract: Point cloud completion aims to recover complete 3D geometry from partial observations caused by limited viewpoints and occlusions. Existing learning-based works, including 3D Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)-based, point-based, and Transformer-based methods, have achieved strong performance on synthetic benchmarks. However, due to the limitations of modality, scalability, and generative capacity, their generalization to novel objects and real-world scenarios remains challenging. In this paper, we propose MGPC, a generalizable multimodal point cloud completion framework that integrates point clouds, RGB images, and text within a unified architecture. MGPC introduces an innovative modality dropout strategy, a Transformer-based fusion module, and a novel progressive generator to improve robustness, scalability, and geometric modeling capability. We further develop an automatic data generation pipeline and construct MGPC-1M, a large-scale benchmark with over 1,000 categories and one million training pairs. Extensive experiments on MGPC-1M and in-the-wild data demonstrate that the proposed method consistently outperforms prior baselines and exhibits strong generalization under real-world conditions.

摘要（中文）：点云补全旨在从由有限视角和遮挡引起的部分观测中恢复完整的3D几何结构。现有的基于学习的方法，包括基于3D卷积神经网络(CNN)，基于点，以及基于Transformer的方法，在合成基准测试上取得了优异的性能。然而，由于模态、可扩展性和生成能力的限制，它们对新对象和真实世界场景的泛化仍然具有挑战性。在本文中，我们提出了MGPC，一个可泛化的多模态点云补全框架，它在一个统一的架构中集成了点云、RGB图像和文本。MGPC引入了一种创新的模态dropout策略，一个基于Transformer的融合模块，以及一个新颖的渐进式生成器，以提高鲁棒性、可扩展性和几何建模能力。我们进一步开发了一个自动数据生成流水线，并构建了MGPC-1M，一个包含超过1000个类别和一百万个训练对的大规模基准。在MGPC-1M和真实场景数据上的大量实验表明，所提出的方法始终优于先前的基线，并在真实世界条件下表现出强大的泛化能力。

Authors: Jiangyuan Liu, Yuhao Zhao, Hongxuan Ma, Zhe Liu, Jian Wang, Wei Zou

Human-in-the-Loop Testing of AI Agents for Air Traffic Control with a Regulated Assessment Framework

简要说明：本文介绍了一个人机协作的评估框架，用于评估空中交通管制中AI代理的性能，该框架使用监管机构认证的模拟器和专家人为指导，以进行真实的性能评估。

TLDR: This paper introduces a human-in-the-loop evaluation framework for AI agents in Air Traffic Control, using a regulator-certified simulator and expert human instructors for realistic performance assessment.

Abstract: We present a rigorous, human-in-the-loop evaluation framework for assessing the performance of AI agents on the task of Air Traffic Control, grounded in a regulator-certified simulator-based curriculum used for training and testing real-world trainee controllers. By leveraging legally regulated assessments and involving expert human instructors in the evaluation process, our framework enables a more authentic and domain-accurate measurement of AI performance. This work addresses a critical gap in the existing literature: the frequent misalignment between academic representations of Air Traffic Control and the complexities of the actual operational environment. It also lays the foundations for effective future human-machine teaming paradigms by aligning machine performance with human assessment targets.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了一种严谨的、人机协同评估框架，用于评估人工智能体在空中交通管制任务上的性能。该框架基于监管机构认证的模拟器课程，该课程用于训练和测试现实世界的管制员学员。通过利用受法律监管的评估方法，并让专家级人类教员参与到评估过程中，我们的框架能够对人工智能性能进行更加真实和领域精确的测量。这项工作解决了现有文献中的一个关键缺口：空中交通管制的学术表示与其真实运行环境的复杂性之间经常存在偏差。它还通过将机器性能与人类评估目标对齐，为未来有效的人机协作模式奠定了基础。

Authors: Ben Carvell, Marc Thomas, Andrew Pace, Christopher Dorney, George De Ath, Richard Everson, Nick Pepper, Adam Keane, Samuel Tomlinson, Richard Cannon

Rethinking Recurrent Neural Networks for Time Series Forecasting: A Reinforced Recurrent Encoder with Prediction-Oriented Proximal Policy Optimization

简要说明：本文介绍了一种新的强化循环编码器RRE-PPO4Pred，它带有一个面向预测的近端策略优化算法，该算法通过自适应地选择 RNN 中的输入特征、隐藏跳跃连接和输出目标来提高时间序列预测的准确性。

TLDR: The paper introduces RRE-PPO4Pred, a novel reinforced recurrent encoder with a prediction-oriented proximal policy optimization algorithm to improve time series forecasting accuracy by adaptively selecting input features, hidden skip connections, and output targets within RNNs.

Abstract: Time series forecasting plays a crucial role in contemporary engineering information systems for supporting decision-making across various industries, where Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs) have been widely adopted due to their capability in modeling sequential data. Conventional RNN-based predictors adopt an encoder-only strategy with sliding historical windows as inputs to forecast future values. However, this approach treats all time steps and hidden states equally without considering their distinct contributions to forecasting, leading to suboptimal performance. To address this limitation, we propose a novel Reinforced Recurrent Encoder with Prediction-oriented Proximal Policy Optimization, RRE-PPO4Pred, which significantly improves time series modeling capacity and forecasting accuracy of the RNN models. The core innovations of this method are: (1) A novel Reinforced Recurrent Encoder (RRE) framework that enhances RNNs by formulating their internal adaptation as a Markov Decision Process, creating a unified decision environment capable of learning input feature selection, hidden skip connection, and output target selection; (2) An improved Prediction-oriented Proximal Policy Optimization algorithm, termed PPO4Pred, which is equipped with a Transformer-based agent for temporal reasoning and develops a dynamic transition sampling strategy to enhance sampling efficiency; (3) A co-evolutionary optimization paradigm to facilitate the learning of the RNN predictor and the policy agent, providing adaptive and interactive time series modeling. Comprehensive evaluations on five real-world datasets indicate that our method consistently outperforms existing baselines, and attains accuracy better than state-of-the-art Transformer models, thus providing an advanced time series predictor in engineering informatics.

摘要（中文）：时间序列预测在当代工程信息系统中发挥着至关重要的作用，它为各行各业的决策提供支持。循环神经网络（RNN）由于其在建模序列数据方面的能力而被广泛采用。传统的基于RNN的预测器采用仅编码器策略，使用滑窗历史数据作为输入来预测未来值。然而，这种方法平等地对待所有时间步和隐藏状态，没有考虑它们对预测的不同贡献，从而导致次优性能。为了解决这个局限性，我们提出了一种新颖的带有面向预测的近端策略优化增强循环编码器，即RRE-PPO4Pred，它显著提高了RNN模型的时间序列建模能力和预测精度。该方法的核心创新点包括：（1）一种新颖的增强循环编码器（RRE）框架，通过将RNN的内部自适应形式化为马尔可夫决策过程来增强RNN，创建了一个统一的决策环境，能够学习输入特征选择、隐藏跳跃连接和输出目标选择；（2）一种改进的面向预测的近端策略优化算法，称为PPO4Pred，它配备了一个基于Transformer的代理用于时间推理，并开发了一种动态转换采样策略来提高采样效率；（3）一种协同进化优化范式，以促进RNN预测器和策略代理的学习，提供自适应和交互式的时间序列建模。在五个真实世界数据集上的综合评估表明，我们的方法始终优于现有的基线，并且获得了比最先进的Transformer模型更好的准确性，从而在工程信息学中提供了一种先进的时间序列预测器。

Authors: Xin Lai, Shiming Deng, Lu Yu, Yumin Lai, Shenghao Qiao, Xinze Zhang

A Preliminary Agentic Framework for Matrix Deflation

简要说明：该论文提出了一种基于Agent的矩阵分解方法，利用LLM和VLM将矩阵分解为rank-1切片，无需固定的norm阈值，并在图像数据集和合成数据上取得了竞争性的结果。

TLDR: This paper introduces an agentic approach to matrix deflation, utilizing LLMs and VLMs to decompose matrices into rank-1 slices without fixed norm thresholds, achieving competitive results on image datasets and synthetic data.

Abstract: Can a small team of agents peel a matrix apart, one rank-1 slice at a time? We propose an agentic approach to matrix deflation in which a solver Large Language Model (LLM) generates rank-1 Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) updates and a Vision Language Model (VLM) accepts or rejects each update and decides when to stop, eliminating fixed norm thresholds. Solver stability is improved through in-context learning (ICL) and types of row/column permutations that expose visually coherent structure. We evaluate on Digits ($8{\times}8$), CIFAR-10 ($32{\times}32$ grayscale), and synthetic ($16{\times}16$) matrices with and without Gaussian noise. In the synthetic noisy case, where the true construction rank $k$ is known, numerical deflation provides the noise target and our best agentic configuration differs by only $1.75$ RMSE of the target. For Digits and CIFAR-10, targets are defined by deflating until the Frobenius norm reaches $10\%$ of the original. Across all settings, our agent achieves competitive results, suggesting that fully agentic, threshold-free deflation is a viable alternative to classical numerical algorithms.

摘要（中文）：一小组智能体能否将一个矩阵逐层剥离，每次剥离一个秩一的切片？我们提出一种基于智能体的矩阵降阶方法，该方法利用一个求解器大型语言模型（LLM）生成秩一奇异值分解（SVD）更新，并利用一个视觉语言模型（VLM）接受或拒绝每次更新，并决定何时停止，从而消除了固定的范数阈值。通过上下文学习（ICL）和暴露视觉连贯结构的行/列置换类型，提高了求解器的稳定性。我们在Digits ($8{\times}8$)、CIFAR-10 ($32{\times}32$ 灰度)以及带和不带高斯噪声的合成($16{\times}16$)矩阵上进行了评估。在合成噪声情况下，当真实构造秩 $k$ 已知时，数值降阶提供了噪声目标，我们最好的智能体配置与目标的均方根误差（RMSE）仅相差$1.75$。对于Digits和CIFAR-10，目标被定义为降阶直到Frobenius范数达到原始范数的$10\%$为止。在所有设置下，我们的智能体均取得了具有竞争力的结果，表明完全基于智能体的、无阈值降阶是经典数值算法的一种可行的替代方案。

Authors: Paimon Goulart, Evangelos E. Papalexakis

Weather-Aware Transformer for Real-Time Route Optimization in Drone-as-a-Service Operations

简要说明：本文介绍了一种基于天气感知的Transformer模型，用于加速DaaS中的路径预测。与传统算法相比，该模型在保持性能的同时，显著提高了计算速度。

TLDR: This paper introduces a weather-aware transformer model for accelerating route prediction in DaaS, achieving significant computational speedup compared to classical algorithms while maintaining performance.

Abstract: This paper presents a novel framework to accelerate route prediction in Drone-as-a-Service operations through weather-aware deep learning models. While classical path-planning algorithms, such as A* and Dijkstra, provide optimal solutions, their computational complexity limits real-time applicability in dynamic environments. We address this limitation by training machine learning and deep learning models on synthetic datasets generated from classical algorithm simulations. Our approach incorporates transformer-based and attention-based architectures that utilize weather heuristics to predict optimal next-node selections while accounting for meteorological conditions affecting drone operations. The attention mechanisms dynamically weight environmental factors including wind patterns, wind bearing, and temperature to enhance routing decisions under adverse weather conditions. Experimental results demonstrate that our weather-aware models achieve significant computational speedup over traditional algorithms while maintaining route optimization performance, with transformer-based architectures showing superior adaptation to dynamic environmental constraints. The proposed framework enables real-time, weather-responsive route optimization for large-scale DaaS operations, representing a substantial advancement in the efficiency and safety of autonomous drone systems.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种新颖的框架，通过感知天气的深度学习模型加速无人机即服务（DaaS）运营中的航线预测。虽然诸如A*和Dijkstra等经典路径规划算法能够提供最优解，但其计算复杂度限制了它们在动态环境中的实时应用。我们通过在由经典算法仿真生成的合成数据集上训练机器学习和深度学习模型来解决这一限制。我们的方法结合了基于Transformer和基于注意力机制的架构，这些架构利用天气启发式方法来预测最优的下一个节点选择，同时考虑影响无人机运营的气象条件。注意力机制动态地权衡包括风向、风向角和温度在内的环境因素，以增强恶劣天气条件下的路由决策。实验结果表明，我们的天气感知模型在保持航线优化性能的同时，相比传统算法实现了显著的计算加速，并且基于Transformer的架构在适应动态环境约束方面表现出更优越的性能。所提出的框架为大规模DaaS运营实现了实时、天气响应式的航线优化，代表了自主无人机系统在效率和安全性方面的重大进步。
